records.jp: 愛央にお願いがあるんだけど、今平気？
records.en_original: Ao, I'd like to ask you for a favor. Is now a good time?
records.en: Ao, I'd like to ask you for a favor. Is now a good time?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんにお願いがあるんだけど、大丈夫かな？
records.en_original: Oh, Ao. I actually wanted to ask you a favor. You okay right now?
records.en: Oh, Ao. I actually wanted to ask you a favor. You okay right now?

records.jp: 星崎さんにお願いしたいことがあるんだけど……
records.en_original: Hoshizaki. I wanted to ask you something...
records.en: Hoshizaki. I wanted to ask you something...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん！　ちょっとお願い聞いてもらえる？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao! Could I get your advice on something?
records.en: Hey, Ao! Could I get your advice on something?

records.jp: 少しお願いがあるのですが、今よろしいですか？
records.en_original: I'd like to ask for a little favor. Is now a good time?
records.en: I'd like to ask for a little favor. Is now a good time?

records.jp: 愛央ー！　ちょっとお願い聞いてー！
records.en_original: Yo, Ao! Help me out a bit!
records.en: Yo, Ao! Help me out a bit!

records.jp: 星崎さんに、少しお願いしたいことがあります。
records.en_original: Ao, I wanted to ask your help with something...
records.en: Ao, I wanted to ask your help with something...

records.jp: 愛央にお願いしたいことがあるんだけど、今大丈夫？
records.en_original: Ao,.I wanted to ask a favor. Is now a good time?
records.en: Ao,.I wanted to ask a favor. Is now a good time?

records.jp: 愛央にお願いしたいことがある
records.en_original: Ao... I have a request...
records.en: Ao... I have a request...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、ちょっといいかな……
records.en_original: Hi, Ao. Is now a good time...?
records.en: Hi, Ao. Is now a good time...?

records.jp: どしたの？　なんか悩みごと？
records.en_original: What's up? Something on your mind?
records.en: What's up? Something on your mind?

records.jp: ねえ、愛央ちゃんは覚えてる？^00この間、探索に出かけた時……
records.en_original: Oh... Do you remember, Ao? The other day, when you were exploring.
records.en: Oh... Do you remember, Ao? The other day, when you were exploring.

records.jp: 虹色に光る野菜……？　みたいなのが生えてて
records.en_original: There was a plant. It...glowed with all the colors of the rainbow.
records.en: There was a plant. It...glowed with all the colors of the rainbow.

records.jp: あー……あったような、なかったような？
records.en_original: Uh... I think I remember something like that.
records.en: Uh... I think I remember something like that.

records.jp: あれって、どんな味がするんだろうね。^00気になるなあ……
records.en_original: I can't help but wonder what it tastes like...
records.en: I can't help but wonder what it tastes like...

records.jp: え、悩みってそれ？^00なーんだ、心配して損した……
records.en_original: That's why you were brooding? And here I was worried about you...
records.en: That's why you were brooding? And here I was worried about you...

records.jp: 食生活について考えるのは大事なことだよ。^00生きていくために絶対必要なんだから
records.en_original: Nothing is more important than our diets, Ao. Food is one of the basic necessities for survival.
records.en: Nothing is more important than our diets, Ao. Food is one of the basic necessities for survival.

records.jp: そりゃそうだけど……^00まあ、今度見かけたら持ってきてあげるよ
records.en_original: Well, yeah, but... Fine, I'll bring some back next time I see one.
records.en: Well, yeah, but... Fine, I'll bring some back next time I see one.

records.jp: こころ、最近元気なさそうだよね？　大丈夫？
records.en_original: Lately, you've been looking down, Kokoro. Is everything alright?
records.en: Lately, you've been looking down, Kokoro. Is everything alright?

records.jp: うーん……ここ最近、なんか調子が出なくって
records.en_original: Ehh... I've just been feeling out of it lately.
records.en: Ehh... I've just been feeling out of it lately.

records.jp: 何か悪いものでも食べた？
records.en_original: Did you eat something weird?
records.en: Did you eat something weird?

records.jp: 変なものは食べてないけど……。^00でも、もしかしたら食事が原因なのかも
records.en_original: Not that I know of... Though, food may actually be the reason.
records.en: Not that I know of... Though, food may actually be the reason.

records.jp: 最近、軽いものしか食べられてなくて……
records.en_original: I've only been eating light meals recently.
records.en: I've only been eating light meals recently.

records.jp: ほほう。たまにはガッツリ食べたいと。^00こころは食いしん坊だなあ
records.en_original: Ahh, and now you're craving something you can pig out on, huh? You always were a big eater.
records.en: Ahh, and now you're craving something you can pig out on, huh? You always were a big eater.

records.jp: うー……茶化さないでよ。^00わたしにとっては死活問題なんだから……
records.en_original: Hey, stop teasing... This is important to me...
records.en: Hey, stop teasing... This is important to me...

records.jp: ごめんごめん。^00んー、どうしたもんかねえ
records.en_original: Aw, I'm sorry. Hmm, I wonder...
records.en: Aw, I'm sorry. Hmm, I wonder...

records.jp: 前から思ってたんだけど
records.en_original: I've been thinking.
records.en: I've been thinking.

records.jp: 何？
records.en_original: What about?
records.en: What about?

records.jp: あなたの戦い方、危なっかしい。^00見ててハラハラする
records.en_original: The way you fight, you put yourself in too much danger. I feel anxious just watching you.
records.en: The way you fight, you put yourself in too much danger. I feel anxious just watching you.

records.jp: えー、そう？^00でも倒せてるんだからいいじゃん
records.en_original: You think so? We're winning, so all's well that ends well, right?
records.en: You think so? We're winning, so all's well that ends well, right?

records.jp: これからもそうとは限らないでしょ。^00この前だってギリギリだったじゃない
records.en_original: Things may not always go this well. Just the other day, you were cutting it close.
records.en: Things may not always go this well. Just the other day, you were cutting it close.

records.jp: 攻撃一辺倒じゃなくて、体力を温存する戦い方も^00考えていかないと
records.en_original: You need to think more about your stamina. You can't be constantly attacking all the time.
records.en: You need to think more about your stamina. You can't be constantly attacking all the time.

records.jp: そういう戦い方もできるもん。^00今までの敵がザコかったからしなかっただけだもん
records.en_original: I could do that if I really wanted. All the demons we've fought so far were so weak, I just didn't have to.
records.en: I could do that if I really wanted. All the demons we've fought so far were so weak, I just didn't have to.

records.jp: じゃあ、証明してみせて
records.en_original: Then prove it to me.
records.en: Then prove it to me.

records.jp: 倒してほしいのがいるんだけど、お願いできる？
records.en_original: There is a demon I'd like for you to defeat for me. Do you mind?
records.en: There is a demon I'd like for you to defeat for me. Do you mind?

records.jp: 素材集めに行こうとすると^00いつもそいつが立ってて邪魔なの
records.en_original: It's always getting in my way while I'm gathering materials.
records.en: It's always getting in my way while I'm gathering materials.

records.jp: いいけど、なんで？
records.en_original: Sure, but why?
records.en: Sure, but why?

records.jp: 理由なら今言ったじゃない
records.en_original: I just told you why.
records.en: I just told you why.

records.jp: いや、伶那さんの強さと性格なら^00自分でさっさと倒しそうな気がして
records.en_original: You're just really strong, and I kinda figured that you're the kind of person to just try and do it yourself.
records.en: You're just really strong, and I kinda figured that you're the kind of person to just try and do it yourself.

records.jp: あなたが得意なタイプの敵みたいだから。^00私が倒すより早いと思って
records.en_original: It looked to me like your kind of demon. I thought you'd be able to defeat it faster.
records.en: It looked to me like your kind of demon. I thought you'd be able to defeat it faster.

records.jp: ふーん。まぁ、伶那さんからのお願いなんて^00珍しいから頑張るか
records.en_original: Huh. Well, it's not every day I get a request from you. I'll take care of it.
records.en: Huh. Well, it's not every day I get a request from you. I'll take care of it.

records.jp: あの、ちょっと良いでしょうか。
records.en_original: Um... Do you have a moment?
records.en: Um... Do you have a moment?

records.jp: 詩帆さん、どうしたの？
records.en_original: What's up, Shiho?
records.en: What's up, Shiho?

records.jp: 今夜の料理のことを考えてたんです
records.en_original: I was thinking about what to make for tonight's dinner.
records.en: I was thinking about what to make for tonight's dinner.

records.jp: あまり作ったことがない料理なので、^00材料を忘れてしまって
records.en_original: I was thinking of making this one dish I don't make very often, and I seem to have forgotten the ingredients.
records.en: I was thinking of making this one dish I don't make very often, and I seem to have forgotten the ingredients.

records.jp: 記憶を辿ってるんですけど、^00中々思い出せないんです
records.en_original: Even with my memories back, I just can't remember...
records.en: Even with my memories back, I just can't remember...

records.jp: 今、手元にレシピがあったらなぁ
records.en_original: If only I had the recipe in front of me...
records.en: If only I had the recipe in front of me...

records.jp: それならいい場所知ってるよ
records.en_original: I know somewhere you might be able to find it.
records.en: I know somewhere you might be able to find it.

records.jp: 本当ですか？^00ぜひ案内してください！
records.en_original: Really? Then, please, lead the way!
records.en: Really? Then, please, lead the way!

records.jp: ココロトープを探索していて時々思うんですけど、^00たまに葉っぱみたいな素材を見かけるじゃないですか
records.en_original: I've been thinking, have you seen those leafy plants around the Heartscape?
records.en: I've been thinking, have you seen those leafy plants around the Heartscape?

records.jp: そうだね
records.en_original: Yeah, I think so.
records.en: Yeah, I think so.

records.jp: あれを煮出して紅茶にできないかなって
records.en_original: I bet we could use it to make some nice tea.
records.en: I bet we could use it to make some nice tea.

records.jp: わお
records.en_original: Ooh.
records.en: Ooh.

records.jp: 喫茶店の娘としては、コーヒーだけじゃなくて^00紅茶にもこだわりたいんです
records.en_original: I don't want to focus too much just on coffee. I need to make sure my tea is up to snuff as well.
records.en: I don't want to focus too much just on coffee. I need to make sure my tea is up to snuff as well.

records.jp: 未知の紅茶に出会えるなら、試してみたいんです！
records.en_original: If this is a chance to discover an unknown tea, then I have to at least try!
records.en: If this is a chance to discover an unknown tea, then I have to at least try!

records.jp: だからって、よくそんな勇気が出るね。^00得体が知れなくない？
records.en_original: Seems a little dangerous to me... You don't even know what those plants are, right?
records.en: Seems a little dangerous to me... You don't even know what those plants are, right?

records.jp: ある程度、向いてそうな素材の目星はついてるんです。^00手伝ってもらえませんか？
records.en_original: I have an idea of which ones are likely to work. Will you lend me a hand?
records.en: I have an idea of which ones are likely to work. Will you lend me a hand?

records.jp: 怖いけど、面白そうだしやってみるか
records.en_original: It's a little scary, but it does sound fun. Let's do it.
records.en: It's a little scary, but it does sound fun. Let's do it.

records.jp: わたしの料理、何かが足りないと思いませんか？
records.en_original: Do you feel like my cooking is...missing something?
records.en: Do you feel like my cooking is...missing something?

records.jp: え？^00いつも美味しいよ
records.en_original: Huh? What are you talking about, it's always delicious.
records.en: Huh? What are you talking about, it's always delicious.

records.jp: そういうことじゃないんです
records.en_original: That's not what I meant.
records.en: That's not what I meant.

records.jp: うーん。強いて言うなら、最近甘いものが続いてるから^00他のものも食べたいかな
records.en_original: Hmm. I guess if I had to say something, we have had a lot of sweet stuff. Might be nice to switch things up a bit.
records.en: Hmm. I guess if I had to say something, we have had a lot of sweet stuff. Might be nice to switch things up a bit.

records.jp: 甘くないもの、ですか
records.en_original: Something savory, then...
records.en: Something savory, then...

records.jp: 麻婆豆腐とか？
records.en_original: Maybe something like mapo tofu?
records.en: Maybe something like mapo tofu?

records.jp: 極端じゃない？
records.en_original: That might be a bit extreme...
records.en: That might be a bit extreme...

records.jp: うん、それがいいですね。^00たまには刺激がないと！
records.en_original: Exactly. We could use a little spice in our lives!
records.en: Exactly. We could use a little spice in our lives!

records.jp: すみません、材料集めをお願いしてもいいですか？
records.en_original: I hate to ask, but would you mind gathering the ingredients?
records.en: I hate to ask, but would you mind gathering the ingredients?

records.jp: いきなり飛びすぎな気もするけど……まあ、いっか。^00詩帆さんの麻婆豆腐食べてみたいし
records.en_original: This might seem like an extreme first step... But I'm pretty interested to try your mapo tofu.
records.en: This might seem like an extreme first step... But I'm pretty interested to try your mapo tofu.

records.jp: 日菜子さん、今ひまー？^00ちょっとおしゃべりしない？
records.en_original: Hinako, you busy right now? Wanna have a chat?
records.en: Hinako, you busy right now? Wanna have a chat?

records.jp: ちょっといい？
records.en_original: ...Can I ask something?
records.en: ...Can I ask something?

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What's the matter?
records.en: What's the matter?

records.jp: なんだか、身体がまだ鈍ってる気がするんだよね。^00戦闘の時とか
records.en_original: I feel like I'm still a little out of shape. Particularly during battle.
records.en: I feel like I'm still a little out of shape. Particularly during battle.

records.jp: そう？^00横で見てる分には全然感じなかったけど
records.en_original: Really? It didn't seem like you were having any trouble to me.
records.en: Really? It didn't seem like you were having any trouble to me.

records.jp: ねぇ、愛央。^00勘を取り戻すの、付き合ってくれないかな？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao? Do you think you can help me get my edge back?
records.en: Hey, Ao? Do you think you can help me get my edge back?

records.jp: 日菜子さんがそう言うなら、いいよ。^00私も一緒の方が楽しいし
records.en_original: If you say so, I'd be more than happy to help! It's a lot more fun with another person.
records.en: If you say so, I'd be more than happy to help! It's a lot more fun with another person.

records.jp: ちょっと工作するのに足りない材料があってさー。^00代わりにとってきてくれない？
records.en_original: So Ao, I'm kinda missing some materials for building stuff. Would you mind finding some replacements for me?
records.en: So Ao, I'm kinda missing some materials for building stuff. Would you mind finding some replacements for me?

records.jp: えー、自分でとってきなよ
records.en_original: What, go get it yourself.
records.en: What, go get it yourself.

records.jp: そうしたいのはやまやまなんだけど、^00モンスターが持ってるヤツなんだよねー
records.en_original: I would if I could. The problem is that they all come from demons.
records.en: I would if I could. The problem is that they all come from demons.

records.jp: 戦えないあたしには無理無理
records.en_original: I can't fight, so there's a zero percent chance that I can get them by myself.
records.en: I can't fight, so there's a zero percent chance that I can get them by myself.

records.jp: ああ、そういうこと……
records.en_original: Oh, I see now.
records.en: Oh, I see now.

records.jp: お礼はするからさ。頼んだ！　この通り！
records.en_original: I promise I'll pay you back!
records.en: I promise I'll pay you back!

records.jp: はいはい。とってきてあげるよー
records.en_original: Fine, fine. I'll get them for you.
records.en: Fine, fine. I'll get them for you.

records.jp: いひひ……実は、ちょっと作りたいものがあってね。^00手伝ってもらえないかなーって
records.en_original: Heehee... There's actually one little thing I'd like your help on.
records.en: Heehee... There's actually one little thing I'd like your help on.

records.jp: ……なんか怪しい。何企んでるの？
records.en_original: ...You're up to something, aren't you?
records.en: ...You're up to something, aren't you?

records.jp: そんなそんな、人聞きの悪い。^00ちょっとした芸術活動だよ
records.en_original: How rude! It's just a little art project of mine.
records.en: How rude! It's just a little art project of mine.

records.jp: なおさら怪しいよ……。何？　絵でも描くの？
records.en_original: That's even more suspicious... You're going to paint something?
records.en: That's even more suspicious... You're going to paint something?

records.jp: いやいや。ほら、よく言うじゃん。^00芸術は爆発だーって
records.en_original: Nothing like that. Let's just say I suddenly got an...explosion of inspiration.
records.en: Nothing like that. Let's just say I suddenly got an...explosion of inspiration.

records.jp: 爆発……って。爆弾でも作るつもり！？
records.en_original: Explosion...? Are you making bombs?!
records.en: Explosion...? Are you making bombs?!

records.jp: まあ、そんなとこ
records.en_original: Pretty much.
records.en: Pretty much.

records.jp: だめだよ！　危ないって！
records.en_original: You can't do that! That's too dangerous!
records.en: You can't do that! That's too dangerous!

records.jp: へーきへーき。爆発、って言っても、^00音が鳴るだけのやつだから。いわゆる爆竹だね
records.en_original: Don't worry so much! It's not really a bomb, it just makes a big noise. Like a firecracker.
records.en: Don't worry so much! It's not really a bomb, it just makes a big noise. Like a firecracker.

records.jp: お願い！　愛央にしか頼めないんだよー！
records.en_original: Pretty please? You're the only person I can ask!
records.en: Pretty please? You're the only person I can ask!

records.jp: うう……そこまで頼まれたら断れないけどさあ
records.en_original: Urgh... It's hard to say no when you say that...
records.en: Urgh... It's hard to say no when you say that...

records.jp: やった！
records.en_original: Woohoo!
records.en: Woohoo!

records.jp: 遊ぼうぜ
records.en_original: Let's party!
records.en: Let's party!

records.jp: 星崎さん、ちゃんと勉強してる？
records.en_original: Hoshizaki, you keeping up with you studying?
records.en: Hoshizaki, you keeping up with you studying?

records.jp: ちょっと直接会って話したいんだけど
records.en_original: I want to talk to you directly...
records.en: I want to talk to you directly...

records.jp: 来て
records.en_original: Come with me.
records.en: Come with me.

records.jp: そういえば、実際にこころが作った秘密基地って、^00ツリーハウスだったんだっけ？
records.en_original: By the way, the secret hideout you made was a tree house, wasn't it?
records.en: By the way, the secret hideout you made was a tree house, wasn't it?

records.jp: うん。近所の林に大きくて丈夫な樹が生えてて……。^00その上のところに
records.en_original: Yeah. There was this big, sturdy tree in the woods nearby. It was on top of that.
records.en: Yeah. There was this big, sturdy tree in the woods nearby. It was on top of that.

records.jp: 本当はそこまで再現できたら良かったのかもだけど……^00中々難しそうだよね
records.en_original: I wish we could recreate that, but...it seems kinda hard.
records.en: I wish we could recreate that, but...it seems kinda hard.

records.jp: そもそも、基地を作れそうな樹がないしね
records.en_original: I don't think there are any suitable trees here in the first place.
records.en: I don't think there are any suitable trees here in the first place.

records.jp: 確かに。まずは樹を植えるところからか……。^00さすがにそこまでしなくてもいいかな
records.en_original: True. We'd need a proper tree first... Well, we probably don't have to do all that.
records.en: True. We'd need a proper tree first... Well, we probably don't have to do all that.

records.jp: ……でも、秘密基地とは関係なく、^00樹を植えるっていうのはいいかも？
records.en_original: But even if we don't use it for the secret hideout, don't you think it'd be nice to plant a tree?
records.en: But even if we don't use it for the secret hideout, don't you think it'd be nice to plant a tree?

records.jp: 何のために？
records.en_original: Then what would we use it for?
records.en: Then what would we use it for?

records.jp: えーと……目印、とか？
records.en_original: Um... Maybe as a landmark?
records.en: Um... Maybe as a landmark?

records.jp: 待ち合わせ場所に使ったり？^00んー……そのためにわざわざ植える？
records.en_original: To use as a meeting place or something? Hmm... Do we really need to plant a tree just for that?
records.en: To use as a meeting place or something? Hmm... Do we really need to plant a tree just for that?

records.jp: あと、樹にもたれて休憩したりとか……
records.en_original: We could sit beneath it and relax in its shade too...
records.en: We could sit beneath it and relax in its shade too...

records.jp: あ、それはなんかいいかも
records.en_original: Yeah, that does sound nice.
records.en: Yeah, that does sound nice.

records.jp: 樹、ありだと思う！
records.en_original: So let's plant a tree already!
records.en: So let's plant a tree already!

records.jp: なんかいつになく推してくる……。^00……こころがそこまで言うなら、植えてみようか
records.en_original: It's not like you to push for something like this, Kokoro. But if you really want to, let's do it!
records.en: It's not like you to push for something like this, Kokoro. But if you really want to, let's do it!

records.jp: 喉、乾いたなぁ
records.en_original: I'm thirsty...
records.en: I'm thirsty...

records.jp: 私も。^00冷蔵庫の麦茶、まだ残ってたっけ
records.en_original: Me too. I think there's some barley tea in the fridge.
records.en: Me too. I think there's some barley tea in the fridge.

records.jp: いつもの麦茶も美味しいけど、^00もっと色んな飲み物が飲めるといいよね
records.en_original: That tea is good and everything, but sometimes I feel like having something else...
records.en: That tea is good and everything, but sometimes I feel like having something else...

records.jp: そうだ！^00自販機作らない？
records.en_original: Oh! Let's make a vending machine!
records.en: Oh! Let's make a vending machine!

records.jp: いいね～。この季節にぴったりじゃん
records.en_original: Sounds good! Perfect for this weather.
records.en: Sounds good! Perfect for this weather.

records.jp: 飲み物だけじゃなくて、^00食べ物の自販機も欲しいな
records.en_original: Not just for drinks! We should make a vending machine with food too!
records.en: Not just for drinks! We should make a vending machine with food too!

records.jp: おやつ程度で料理班にお願いするのも悪いし
records.en_original: I feel bad asking the cooking team to make me something when all I want is a little snack.
records.en: I feel bad asking the cooking team to make me something when all I want is a little snack.

records.jp: 食べ物って、ハンバーガーとか？
records.en_original: Food, huh? Do you mean like, burgers and stuff?
records.en: Food, huh? Do you mean like, burgers and stuff?

records.jp: え、ハンバーガーの自販機があるの？
records.en_original: Huh? There are vending machines with burgers?
records.en: Huh? There are vending machines with burgers?

records.jp: うん、滅多に見かけないけどね
records.en_original: Yeah. They're few and far between, though.
records.en: Yeah. They're few and far between, though.

records.jp: 食べてみたい！
records.en_original: I want to try one!
records.en: I want to try one!

records.jp: よっしゃ！　作るぞー！
records.en_original: Sounds good. Let's do it!
records.en: Sounds good. Let's do it!

records.jp: ちょっといい？
records.en_original: Got a second?
records.en: Got a second?

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What's up?
records.en: What's up?

records.jp: 花を植える場所を探してて
records.en_original: I'm looking for a place to plant some flowers.
records.en: I'm looking for a place to plant some flowers.

records.jp: あら、伶那さんって^00シンプル志向と思いきや意外と乙女？
records.en_original: Whoa. I didn't know you cared for pretty things. You're more ladylike than I'd thought!
records.en: Whoa. I didn't know you cared for pretty things. You're more ladylike than I'd thought!

records.jp: というより、もったいないと思って。^00たまに探索とかで種を見つけたりするから
records.en_original: I'd rather think of it as putting something to good use. We often find seeds on our expeditions.
records.en: I'd rather think of it as putting something to good use. We often find seeds on our expeditions.

records.jp: それにまぁ、少しは彩りがあった方がいいとも思うし
records.en_original: So I thought that we could add some color to the place.
records.en: So I thought that we could add some color to the place.

records.jp: そういうことね。^00じゃ、さくっと作っちゃいますか
records.en_original: Oh, I see. Well, let's make a place for them right now!
records.en: Oh, I see. Well, let's make a place for them right now!

records.jp: 日菜子さん、何か作りたいものある？
records.en_original: Hinako, is there anything you wanna make?
records.en: Hinako, is there anything you wanna make?

records.jp: 作りたいもの、か
records.en_original: Anything I want to make...?
records.en: Anything I want to make...?

records.jp: キャンプファイヤー
records.en_original: A bonfire.
records.en: A bonfire.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: キャンプファイヤー作りたい、かも
records.en_original: I think I'd like to make a bonfire.
records.en: I think I'd like to make a bonfire.

records.jp: いいけど、ちょっと意外。なんで？
records.en_original: Not what I was expecting, but sure. Any reason why?
records.en: Not what I was expecting, but sure. Any reason why?

records.jp: 林間学校とコンクールの時期が被ったことがあって。^00チャンス逃しちゃったんだよね
records.en_original: I had a ballet competition at the same time as my school's camping trip, so I missed my chance then.
records.en: I had a ballet competition at the same time as my school's camping trip, so I missed my chance then.

records.jp: いつかできる時があったら、^00してみたいなってずっと思ってたの
records.en_original: But I've always wanted to have a bonfire.
records.en: But I've always wanted to have a bonfire.

records.jp: なるほどね。^00よーし。日菜子さん、楽しみにしてて！
records.en_original: Ah, I see. All right, Hinako. Prepare yourself!
records.en: Ah, I see. All right, Hinako. Prepare yourself!

records.jp: こころ、用事って終わったー？
records.en_original: Kokoro, did you finish what you had to do?
records.en: Kokoro, did you finish what you had to do?

records.jp: えっと、まだ
records.en_original: Uhhh... not yet.
records.en: Uhhh... not yet.

records.jp: ふーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 星崎さん、時間ある？
records.en_original: Hoshizaki. Do you have some time?
records.en: Hoshizaki. Do you have some time?

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: Something up?
records.en: Something up?

records.jp: もっと戦うことに慣れておきたくて。^00“向こうの世界”に付き合ってほしいの
records.en_original: I'd like you to come with me to the Faraway. I want to get a little more used to fighting.
records.en: I'd like you to come with me to the Faraway. I want to get a little more used to fighting.

records.jp: ほら、金城さんだけ学校に残すの、^00かわいそうじゃない？
records.en_original: I feel bad always having to leave Kinjou behind at the school.
records.en: I feel bad always having to leave Kinjou behind at the school.

records.jp: 金城さんを守りながら戦えるくらい強くなれば、^00連れていってあげられるかと思って
records.en_original: If I was strong enough to protect her while we fought, we could bring her along.
records.en: If I was strong enough to protect her while we fought, we could bring her along.

records.jp: 伶那さん……優しいね
records.en_original: Rena... You really are kind.
records.en: Rena... You really are kind.

records.jp: 別に、普通でしょ
records.en_original: Oh, please. It's only fair.
records.en: Oh, please. It's only fair.

records.jp: あはは、了解。^00それじゃあ、行こっか
records.en_original: Haha, all right, let's go do this thing.
records.en: Haha, all right, let's go do this thing.

records.jp: 勇希、何か手伝えることある？
records.en_original: Yuki, is there anything I can help you with?
records.en: Yuki, is there anything I can help you with?

records.jp: もしかして、手持無沙汰？
records.en_original: Are you bored?
records.en: Are you bored?

records.jp: うん。^00私じゃあんま戦力にならないかもだけど
records.en_original: Yeah. I can't guarantee I'd be of much help, but...
records.en: Yeah. I can't guarantee I'd be of much help, but...

records.jp: いやいや、人手は多い方が助かるよ。^00ちょっとずつ慣れてもらえばいいし！
records.en_original: No, I'd appreciate the help! The more the merrier!
records.en: No, I'd appreciate the help! The more the merrier!

records.jp: そうだなあ……。暇なら、^00練習がてらサンドイッチでも作ってみてよ
records.en_original: Now, let's see... How about making some sandwiches as practice?
records.en: Now, let's see... How about making some sandwiches as practice?

records.jp: サンドイッチね。^00りょーかい、やってみる
records.en_original: Sandwiches, huh? All right, leave it to me!
records.en: Sandwiches, huh? All right, leave it to me!

records.jp: 雨漏りの対策、^00こころはどうすればいいと思う？
records.en_original: Kokoro, what do you think we should do about the leaks?
records.en: Kokoro, what do you think we should do about the leaks?

records.jp: うーん、どうすればいいかはわからないけど……
今使ってるバケツだとすぐ溢れちゃうから、^00大きな容器に交換しないとね
records.en_original: This bucket's about to overflow, so we'll need to get a bigger container.
records.en: This bucket's about to overflow, so we'll need to get a bigger container.

records.jp: とりあえずは、容器に水が溜まったら捨てて、^00溜まったら捨てて……
それを繰り返すしかないんじゃないかなあ
なるほど……。^00とにかく、新しい容器を用意しないとだね
伶那さんはなにかいいアイデア浮かんだ？
さっぱり……
ただ、濡れたままにしておくのも危ないから^00とりあえず周りは拭いておいたほうが良いんじゃない？
どこかにタオルとかなかったっけ……
ふっふっふ。思いついたよ、名案を
本当！？
愛央は雨の中外出するとき、どうする？
え……傘をさす？
それは、どうして？
濡れないため？
じゃあ、屋上のひび割れを濡らさないようにするには^00どうすればいいと思う？
……まさか
そう！　傘を置けばいいんだよ！
ひょっとしてあたしって天才なのでは！？
いやあ？　絶対うまくいかないと思う
まあまあ。^00モノは試しにさ、やってみようよ！
うーん、試す価値はある……のか？
んー、食べ物には不自由してないけど、^00やっぱりレパートリーは限られてくるよね
records.en_original: Hmm... We've got no shortage of food, but our menu could be expanded a bit.
records.en: Hmm... We've got no shortage of food, but our menu could be expanded a bit.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、何か食べたいものでもあるの？
records.en_original: Is there anything in particular you're craving, Ao?
records.en: Is there anything in particular you're craving, Ao?

records.jp: んー、そうだなあ……。^00コンビニのホットスナックとか、たまに恋しくなるなあ
records.en_original: Hmm... Let's see. Sometimes I find myself missing the hot snacks from convenience stores.
records.en: Hmm... Let's see. Sometimes I find myself missing the hot snacks from convenience stores.

records.jp: ホットスナックっていうと……。^00フライドチキンとか、焼き鳥とか？
records.en_original: Convenience store snacks... Like fried chicken, or chicken skewers?
records.en: Convenience store snacks... Like fried chicken, or chicken skewers?

records.jp: そうそう。後は定番の肉まんとか……^00たこ焼きとかも美味しいよねえ
records.en_original: Exactly. And meat buns, takoyaki...
records.en: Exactly. And meat buns, takoyaki...

records.jp: たこ焼きなら、わたし作れるよ
records.en_original: I'm sure I could handle making takoyaki.
records.en: I'm sure I could handle making takoyaki.

records.jp: え、マジ？
records.en_original: Huh? Really?
records.en: Huh? Really?

records.jp: 昔、親戚のおじさんがお祭りの時に屋台を出してて、^00それの手伝いで作り方教わったんだ
records.en_original: My uncle used to run a food stall at our local festivals. He taught me when I was helping out.
records.en: My uncle used to run a food stall at our local festivals. He taught me when I was helping out.

records.jp: たこ焼きの屋台かあ……いいかも！^00せっかくなら、屋台ごと作っちゃおうよ！
records.en_original: That'd be a great! We should make our own takoyaki stand!
records.en: That'd be a great! We should make our own takoyaki stand!

records.jp: 食事とかには不自由しなくなってきたけど、^00娯楽がまだまだ足りないよねえ
records.en_original: Y'know, we've got plenty to eat now, but there's not much to do for fun around here.
records.en: Y'know, we've got plenty to eat now, but there's not much to do for fun around here.

records.jp: 娯楽かあ……んー、ゲームとか？^00私、スマホゲームくらいしかやってなかったけど
records.en_original: Fun? You mean like, games? I used to play some games on my phone, but that's about it.
records.en: Fun? You mean like, games? I used to play some games on my phone, but that's about it.

records.jp: スマホゲームかあ。あたしはやらないなあ。^00面白いの？
records.en_original: Ah, mobile games... I never played any. Are they fun?
records.en: Ah, mobile games... I never played any. Are they fun?

records.jp: 面白くて続けてたやつもいくつかあるよ。^00たまーに課金したりもしてたし
records.en_original: There were a few games that I was pretty into. I even bought some stuff in them.
records.en: There were a few games that I was pretty into. I even bought some stuff in them.

records.jp: こっちに来てからはログインできなくなっちゃったけど
records.en_original: But I haven't been able to log in since I came here.
records.en: But I haven't been able to log in since I came here.

records.jp: ほほう……キャラを当てるやつだね。^00それ、アリかも
records.en_original: Oho... Those games where you try to get certain characters, right? We could do something with that.
records.en: Oho... Those games where you try to get certain characters, right? We could do something with that.

records.jp: いくら勇希が器用でも、^00いきなりゲームを作るのは無理じゃない？
records.en_original: Even as clever as you are, I think making a video game is a bit of a stretch.
records.en: Even as clever as you are, I think making a video game is a bit of a stretch.

records.jp: ゲームじゃなくてさ、リアルなカプセルトイ。^00ゲーセンとか、駅とかに置いてあるじゃん
records.en_original: Not a video game, a capsule machine. Like the ones they have at arcades or train stations.
records.en: Not a video game, a capsule machine. Like the ones they have at arcades or train stations.

records.jp: ああ、なるほど。商品がカプセルに入ってるやつ
records.en_original: Oh, gotcha. The ones with the little toys inside.
records.en: Oh, gotcha. The ones with the little toys inside.

records.jp: そうそう。あれなら作れそうじゃん。^00中身もテキトーに余ったものとか入れて
records.en_original: Yeah! That seems doable, right? And we can throw some stuff together for the prizes inside!
records.en: Yeah! That seems doable, right? And we can throw some stuff together for the prizes inside!

records.jp: それ、面白いかなあ……
records.en_original: Sure, but would that be fun...?
records.en: Sure, but would that be fun...?

records.jp: 物は試し！　作ってみよ！
records.en_original: Only one way to find out! Let's do it!
records.en: Only one way to find out! Let's do it!

records.jp: 星崎さん、作ってみたいものがあるんです。^00作れるかわからないんですけど
records.en_original: Ao, there's something I'd like to make, but I don't know if it's possible.
records.en: Ao, there's something I'd like to make, but I don't know if it's possible.

records.jp: 何？　とりあえず言ってみてよ
records.en_original: What is it? Tell me what it is and we'll see.
records.en: What is it? Tell me what it is and we'll see.

records.jp: 駅なんですけど
records.en_original: A train station.
records.en: A train station.

records.jp: え！？　駅って、ホームのこと？
records.en_original: What?! Like a train platform and the works?
records.en: What?! Like a train platform and the works?

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: Why?
records.en: Why?

records.jp: 電車が直接学校まで乗り込んでくれたら、^00通学が楽なのにって思ったことありません？
records.en_original: Haven't you ever wished there was a train that stopped right at school? It'd make commuting so easy.
records.en: Haven't you ever wished there was a train that stopped right at school? It'd make commuting so easy.

records.jp: それはわかるけど
records.en_original: Well sure, but...
records.en: Well sure, but...

records.jp: 休み時間に隣町まで^00気分転換しに行くことだってできますし
records.en_original: We could even take a train to the next town over in our downtime for a change of scenery.
records.en: We could even take a train to the next town over in our downtime for a change of scenery.

records.jp: その夢を、雰囲気だけでも^00味わってみたくありませんか？
records.en_original: Don't you want to live that dream? Even if it's just pretend?
records.en: Don't you want to live that dream? Even if it's just pretend?

records.jp: それにここだったら、海の見える駅のような雰囲気に^00することだってできるんですよ！
records.en_original: And if we built it here, it'd feel like a seaside train station!
records.en: And if we built it here, it'd feel like a seaside train station!

records.jp: わかったわかった！^00とりあえず、作ってみよう！
records.en_original: Okay, got it! I'll make it right away!
records.en: Okay, got it! I'll make it right away!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、愛央ちゃん。^00実は、お願いしたいことがあるのです
records.en_original: Ao, Ao! I wanted to ask a favor of you...
records.en: Ao, Ao! I wanted to ask a favor of you...

records.jp: ん？　なにー？
records.en_original: Hmm? What's up?
records.en: Hmm? What's up?

records.jp: ちょっと、灯りがほしいなあと思って。^00校舎の周りって、夜になると暗いから
records.en_original: I was thinking that I wanted some lights. It gets really dark around the school at night.
records.en: I was thinking that I wanted some lights. It gets really dark around the school at night.

records.jp: あー、たしかに。^00じゃあ、街灯でもたてよっか
records.en_original: Ah, yeah. Let's set up some streetlights, then.
records.en: Ah, yeah. Let's set up some streetlights, then.

records.jp: んー……だったら、石灯籠がいいかなあ
records.en_original: Uhh... I was thinking more like stone lanterns...
records.en: Uhh... I was thinking more like stone lanterns...

records.jp: 石灯籠？　こころ、渋いね……
records.en_original: Stone lanterns? Wow, you've got taste, huh?
records.en: Stone lanterns? Wow, you've got taste, huh?

records.jp: わたし、電気の灯りより火の灯りの方が好きなの。^00見てるとホッとするっていうか……
records.en_original: I prefer the light of a fire to electric lighting. It feels comforting.
records.en: I prefer the light of a fire to electric lighting. It feels comforting.

records.jp: そういえば、火の揺らめきには、人の精神を^00落ち着かせる効果があるって聞いたことあるかも
records.en_original: That makes sense. I think I've heard that the movement of a flame has a calming effect on people.
records.en: That makes sense. I think I've heard that the movement of a flame has a calming effect on people.

records.jp: うんうん。石灯籠があれば、みんなの心も^00リラックスすると思うなあ
records.en_original: Yeah... So maybe the lanterns could help everyone relax.
records.en: Yeah... So maybe the lanterns could help everyone relax.

records.jp: よーし、じゃあ作ってみますか！
records.en_original: Okay! I'll get started, then!
records.en: Okay! I'll get started, then!

records.jp: ちょっといい？
records.en_original: Are you free now?
records.en: Are you free now?

records.jp: どうしたの、こころ？
records.en_original: What's the matter, Kokoro?
records.en: What's the matter, Kokoro?

records.jp: この前、詩帆ちゃんとも話してたんだけど^00もう少し、食材確保しておきたいなあって……
records.en_original: Shiho and I were talking the other day, and we think that we should stock up on food supplies.
records.en: Shiho and I were talking the other day, and we think that we should stock up on food supplies.

records.jp: ああ、それはたしかに。^00これだけ人数がいると、消費も早いしね
records.en_original: Ah, you're probably right. We won't last long with so many people.
records.en: Ah, you're probably right. We won't last long with so many people.

records.jp: うん。わたしも、狩ってるんだけど^00まだまだ足りてなくて……
records.en_original: Yeah. I've been hunting, but it's just not enough.
records.en: Yeah. I've been hunting, but it's just not enough.

records.jp: 狩ってる……？
records.en_original: Hunting...?
records.en: Hunting...?

records.jp: ま、まあ。^00んじゃ、私も食材集め手伝うよ
records.en_original: Okay. Why don't I help out gathering ingredients too, then?
records.en: Okay. Why don't I help out gathering ingredients too, then?

records.jp: わ、いいの？　そうしてくれると助かるよー
records.en_original: Ooh, you will? That would be such a huge help.
records.en: Ooh, you will? That would be such a huge help.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃーん……
records.en_original: Heeeeey, Ao...
records.en: Heeeeey, Ao...

records.jp: どうしたの？　なんか悩みごと？
records.en_original: What's up? Something on your mind?
records.en: What's up? Something on your mind?

records.jp: 折角とってきた食材が、腐ってて……^00もったいないことしちゃったなーって
records.en_original: All that food we worked so hard to gather... Some of it's become rotten. What a waste...
records.en: All that food we worked so hard to gather... Some of it's become rotten. What a waste...

records.jp: ああ、なるほど……
records.en_original: Oh, that's too bad...
records.en: Oh, that's too bad...

records.jp: 食生活に関しては、^00人一番気を配ってるもんね
records.en_original: Kokoro is always the most worried about our food supplies...
records.en: Kokoro is always the most worried about our food supplies...

records.jp: いざという時のために、保存が効く食材も^00ちゃんと用意しておきたいよね
records.en_original: For now, I wanna properly preserve our food supplies.
records.en: For now, I wanna properly preserve our food supplies.

records.jp: 確かにねー^00それなら、私も集めるの手伝うよ
records.en_original: Good idea! I can help you gather things.
records.en: Good idea! I can help you gather things.

records.jp: うん。よろしくね、愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: That would be great. I'm counting on you, Ao!
records.en: That would be great. I'm counting on you, Ao!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、わたし……ここには生きて行くうえで^00大切なものがないと思うの
records.en_original: Hey, Ao... I was thinking that we're missing something very important in our lives here.
records.en: Hey, Ao... I was thinking that we're missing something very important in our lives here.

records.jp: えっ！？　な、なんだろう……愛とか？
records.en_original: Wha?! Y-you mean like, love or something?
records.en: Wha?! Y-you mean like, love or something?

records.jp: そういう哲学的な話じゃなくて。食料の話だよー
records.en_original: I'm not trying to be philosophical here. I'm talking about food.
records.en: I'm not trying to be philosophical here. I'm talking about food.

records.jp: あ、そっちかー
records.en_original: Ohhh, got it.
records.en: Ohhh, got it.

records.jp: ココロトープに食材探しに行くのもいいけど……^00安全な場所で食材確保したほうがよくないかなあ
records.en_original: We can get ingredients in the Heartscape, but wouldn't it be better to get them from somewhere safe?
records.en: We can get ingredients in the Heartscape, but wouldn't it be better to get them from somewhere safe?

records.jp: うーん、たしかにこころの言う通りかも
records.en_original: Hmm, yeah, you have a point.
records.en: Hmm, yeah, you have a point.

records.jp: だから、たんぼ作らない？^00たんぼがあれば、お米が食べられるよ
records.en_original: So, what if we made a rice field? We'd be able to eat all the rice we wanted.
records.en: So, what if we made a rice field? We'd be able to eat all the rice we wanted.

records.jp: おお、いいね！^00やっぱ、日本人の主食はお米だし！
records.en_original: Wow, that's a great idea! Rice is a staple food, after all!
records.en: Wow, that's a great idea! Rice is a staple food, after all!

records.jp: うん。よろしくね、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's do it, Ao!
records.en: Yeah. Let's do it, Ao!

records.jp: ……そういえば、今日は風が強いね
records.en_original: Hmm. It's rather windy today...
records.en: Hmm. It's rather windy today...

records.jp: 言われてみれば。ここの電力の仕組みって謎だけど、^00停電することとかあるのかな？
records.en_original: Now that I think about it, I don't know how this place is powered. What would we do if the electricity went out?
records.en: Now that I think about it, I don't know how this place is powered. What would we do if the electricity went out?

records.jp: どんな事態にも対応できるように、^00あらかじめ対策しておく方がいいかもね
records.en_original: It might be a good idea to consider how we would handle various situations before they occur.
records.en: It might be a good idea to consider how we would handle various situations before they occur.

records.jp: 対策と言うと……発電機を作るってことか。^00ここでできそうなのは太陽光とか、風力とか？
records.en_original: We could make a power generator. Do you think solar energy would work? Or maybe wind?
records.en: We could make a power generator. Do you think solar energy would work? Or maybe wind?

records.jp: 安定はしないかもしれないけど、^00夜間にも発電できるのは風力の方じゃない？
records.en_original: It might not be completely reliable, but wind might be better since it can generate power at night.
records.en: It might not be completely reliable, but wind might be better since it can generate power at night.

records.jp: よっし！　それじゃあ風力発電機、作っちゃおっか
records.en_original: Sounds good! I'll make us a wind generator, then!
records.en: Sounds good! I'll make us a wind generator, then!

records.jp: 停電して真っ暗になっちゃって、^00伶那さんが怖がるといけないからね！
records.en_original: We can't have any nighttime power outages leaving you shivering in the dark!
records.en: We can't have any nighttime power outages leaving you shivering in the dark!

records.jp: 誰が！
records.en_original: Who said—?
records.en: Who said—?

records.jp: そういえば星崎さんに頼みたいことが^00あるんだ
records.en_original: Hoshizaki, there was actually something I wanted to ask you.
records.en: Hoshizaki, there was actually something I wanted to ask you.

records.jp: えっ、どうしたの伶那さん。珍しいね
records.en_original: That's pretty rare. What is it, Rena?
records.en: That's pretty rare. What is it, Rena?

records.jp: ……少し前に戦った敵、ものすごく強くて、^00なんとか倒したって状態だったでしょ？
records.en_original: That enemy we fought... It was so powerful, we barely pulled through.
records.en: That enemy we fought... It was so powerful, we barely pulled through.

records.jp: それは……うん。確かに強かった
records.en_original: Oh, that... Yeah, it was tough.
records.en: Oh, that... Yeah, it was tough.

records.jp: だから普段からもっともっと^00鍛えておかないとって思って
records.en_original: It made me realize that I have far to go in my own training.
records.en: It made me realize that I have far to go in my own training.

records.jp: ひとまず倒せるだけモンスターを倒して、^00戦闘スキルを磨きたいのよね
records.en_original: I'd like to focus on defeating as many demons as possible to polish my battle skills.
records.en: I'd like to focus on defeating as many demons as possible to polish my battle skills.

records.jp: それはまた百人組手みたいな修行法だね……
records.en_original: Something tells me you won't be satisfied with just a couple demons...
records.en: Something tells me you won't be satisfied with just a couple demons...

records.jp: それくらい気合入れないと、訓練にならないでしょ？^00でも万が一を考えたら、誰かと一緒の方がいいし
records.en_original: What good is training if it isn't difficult? But I do want someone with me. You never know what may happen out there.
records.en: What good is training if it isn't difficult? But I do want someone with me. You never know what may happen out there.

records.jp: よし、そういうことならこの愛央さんが引き受けた！^00敵をばんばん倒して、修行しまくりだ！
records.en_original: If that's the case, I'm your girl! We'll beat up demons until there aren't any left to beat up!
records.en: If that's the case, I'm your girl! We'll beat up demons until there aren't any left to beat up!

records.jp: ちょっといい？
records.en_original: Got a second?
records.en: Got a second?

records.jp: 伶那さん？　……どうかした？
records.en_original: Rena? Is something wrong?
records.en: Rena? Is something wrong?

records.jp: 星崎さん。よければまた手伝ってもらえない？^00モンスター退治
records.en_original: Hoshizaki, I'd like your help with taking care of demons again.
records.en: Hoshizaki, I'd like your help with taking care of demons again.

records.jp: モンスター？^00もちろんいいけど、また修行？
records.en_original: Fighting demons? Of course I can help. Is this to train?
records.en: Fighting demons? Of course I can help. Is this to train?

records.jp: そう。でも今回はその辺にいる雑魚じゃなくて、^00できるだけ強いやつと戦いたいの
records.en_original: Yes. Though this time, I'd prefer to focus on something more powerful.
records.en: Yes. Though this time, I'd prefer to focus on something more powerful.

records.jp: ……いよいよ世界システムを相手にするわけだし。^00こっちもできる準備は全部しておかないとね
records.en_original: We're about to face the World System soon. I need to prepare for it as best I can.
records.en: We're about to face the World System soon. I need to prepare for it as best I can.

records.jp: そうだね……。うん、やろう！^00しっかり修行して、万全の状態にしておくんだ！
records.en_original: Right... Okay, let's do it! We'll train hard so that we can be in tip-top condition!
records.en: Right... Okay, let's do it! We'll train hard so that we can be in tip-top condition!

records.jp: ありがと、星崎さん。^00……本当は、戦わずに済めばそれが一番なんだけどね
records.en_original: Thank you, Hoshizaki. Truthfully, I'd prefer to avoid fighting at all if it was possible.
records.en: Thank you, Hoshizaki. Truthfully, I'd prefer to avoid fighting at all if it was possible.

records.jp: 伶那さん、最近体調悪そうにしてるよね^00……大丈夫？
records.en_original: Rena, you don't look so good recently. Are you feeling all right?
records.en: Rena, you don't look so good recently. Are you feeling all right?

records.jp: 平気。体調に問題があるわけじゃないし。^00ただ……
records.en_original: I'm fine. I feel completely healthy physically. It's just...
records.en: I'm fine. I feel completely healthy physically. It's just...

records.jp: 共同生活をしてる以上仕方ないんだけど、^00人目を気にせずに過ごす時間、あんまりないなって
records.en_original: I realize it can't be helped since we're all living together, but there's not much privacy to be had here.
records.en: I realize it can't be helped since we're all living together, but there's not much privacy to be had here.

records.jp: まあ、ストレス抱えるのもよくないよねー
records.en_original: But it's not good to be so stressed out, either...
records.en: But it's not good to be so stressed out, either...

records.jp: じゃあさ、人目を気にしなくて済む場所、作る？^00ただ個室を作るんじゃ味気ないし……テントとか！
records.en_original: Well, what if I made a place for you to have some privacy? A room would be boring... Maybe a tent?
records.en: Well, what if I made a place for you to have some privacy? A room would be boring... Maybe a tent?

records.jp: テント？^00……星崎さんにしては悪くない案かも
records.en_original: A tent? That's not a terrible idea for you, Hoshizaki.
records.en: A tent? That's not a terrible idea for you, Hoshizaki.

records.jp: 多少引っかかるコメントだったけども！^00伶那さんのために、ここは私が一肌脱ぎましょう！
records.en_original: Although that comment stung a bit...I'll still help you out, Rena!
records.en: Although that comment stung a bit...I'll still help you out, Rena!

records.jp: あー……星崎さん……。^00……やっぱりなんでもない
records.en_original: Hey, Hoshizaki. ...Nah, forget it.
records.en: Hey, Hoshizaki. ...Nah, forget it.

records.jp: ちょっとちょっとおねーさん。^00そんな言い方されて気にならないわけがないっしょ？
records.en_original: Hold up, hold up! You can't just leave it at that.
records.en: Hold up, hold up! You can't just leave it at that.

records.jp: その……絵を……
records.en_original: I, um... The pictures...
records.en: I, um... The pictures...

records.jp: ん？　絵って、伶那さんが描いてるやつ？
records.en_original: Hm? You mean the pictures you draw, Rena?
records.en: Hm? You mean the pictures you draw, Rena?

records.jp: うん……。それを人に見てもらえる場所が^00もしあったら……ってちょっと思ってて
records.en_original: Yeah... I just thought, if there was somewhere to put them where people could see...
records.en: Yeah... I just thought, if there was somewhere to put them where people could see...

records.jp: いいじゃんいいじゃん！^00みんなきっと興味持ってくれるよ！
records.en_original: That sounds great! I'm sure everyone will want to see them!
records.en: That sounds great! I'm sure everyone will want to see them!

records.jp: で、でもそこまで派手にやりたいわけじゃないの。^00フラッと立ち寄って覗いてくくらいのが理想で
records.en_original: B-but I don't want it to stand out too much. Just a small thing people could glance at in passing.
records.en: B-but I don't want it to stand out too much. Just a small thing people could glance at in passing.

records.jp: えー。どうせならディスプレイもちゃんとしてさ。^00見に来た人に楽しんでもらえるようにしたくない？
records.en_original: Aww, I think we should have a proper display for your work. Don't you want people to enjoy it?
records.en: Aww, I think we should have a proper display for your work. Don't you want people to enjoy it?

records.jp: それは……そうかもしれないけど……
records.en_original: Well... Maybe, but...
records.en: Well... Maybe, but...

records.jp: でしょ？　伶那さん、ここは私に任せてよ！^00ちょっと考えがあるからさ
records.en_original: Right? Just leave it to me, Rena! I have an idea.
records.en: Right? Just leave it to me, Rena! I have an idea.

records.jp: 星崎さん。お願いがあるんです
records.en_original: Ao, I have a favor to ask.
records.en: Ao, I have a favor to ask.

records.jp: え！　詩帆さんの頼み？^00お料理の味見なら、喜んで引き受けちゃうよ！
records.en_original: A favor for Shiho? I'd be happy to help with all of your food tasting needs!
records.en: A favor for Shiho? I'd be happy to help with all of your food tasting needs!

records.jp: すみません。今日のお願いは、少し違うんです。^00実は、食材集めをお手伝いしてほしいんです
records.en_original: I'm sorry, but today's request is a little different. I actually wanted some help gathering ingredients.
records.en: I'm sorry, but today's request is a little different. I actually wanted some help gathering ingredients.

records.jp: いいけど、なんかやけに深刻そうだね？
records.en_original: Sure, but why? It seems like that's pretty serious.
records.en: Sure, but why? It seems like that's pretty serious.

records.jp: わたし、運動神経が本当に鈍いじゃないですか。^00本当は、戦うのも怖いし……
records.en_original: I'm sure you know by now that I'm not very athletic... The truth is, I'm scared of fighting.
records.en: I'm sure you know by now that I'm not very athletic... The truth is, I'm scared of fighting.

records.jp: えっ！？　詩帆さんすごい戦えるのに、^00そんな風に不安に思ってたんだ！？
records.en_original: What?! You're amazing at fighting! I would never have guess that you felt like that!
records.en: What?! You're amazing at fighting! I would never have guess that you felt like that!

records.jp: はい。一応先輩なので、隠していましたけど……^00ひとりで食材を集めに行くのが、少し不安なんです
records.en_original: I am. I hid it, wanting to set a good example because I'm older than you, but... I'm scared to go collect materials alone.
records.en: I am. I hid it, wanting to set a good example because I'm older than you, but... I'm scared to go collect materials alone.

records.jp: ……詩帆さん。^00実は私も体育って得意な方じゃないんだよね
records.en_original: Shiho... It's okay, I'm no good at physical stuff either.
records.en: Shiho... It's okay, I'm no good at physical stuff either.

records.jp: だからさ、特訓しに行くつもりで、一緒に行こ！
records.en_original: So we'll go together! Think of it as training!
records.en: So we'll go together! Think of it as training!

records.jp: ……ふふ。ありがとうございます
records.en_original: Hehe. Thank you.
records.en: Hehe. Thank you.

records.jp: 詩帆さんの喫茶店って、ココロトープで見たけど、^00居心地良さそうだったよね
records.en_original: Shiho, your cafe looked really cozy from what I saw in the Heartscape.
records.en: Shiho, your cafe looked really cozy from what I saw in the Heartscape.

records.jp: そう言ってもらえると、嬉しいです。^00元の世界に戻ったら、星崎さんにも、来てほしいです
records.en_original: Oh, I'm happy to hear you say that. When we get back to our world, you've got to come visit!
records.en: Oh, I'm happy to hear you say that. When we get back to our world, you've got to come visit!

records.jp: 喫茶店って、どんなとこにあったの？^00ちょい外れの隠れ家系とか？
records.en_original: What kind of area was the cafe in? Was it a hole-in-the-wall off the beaten path?
records.en: What kind of area was the cafe in? Was it a hole-in-the-wall off the beaten path?

records.jp: ふふ……いいえ。^00普通の商店街の中にある、普通の喫茶店ですよ
records.en_original: Hehe. No. It's just a regular cafe on a regular shopping street.
records.en: Hehe. No. It's just a regular cafe on a regular shopping street.

records.jp: あの店はわたしの居場所でしたから、^00商店街のゲートを見る度にほっとしたものです
records.en_original: That cafe was my home. I'd feel such a sense of relief when I saw the sign for the shopping area.
records.en: That cafe was my home. I'd feel such a sense of relief when I saw the sign for the shopping area.

records.jp: ――ああ、今日も帰って来たんだな、って
records.en_original: It felt like it was welcoming me home.
records.en: It felt like it was welcoming me home.

records.jp: 帰って来た……かぁ……。^00……そうだ！
records.en_original: Like it was welcoming you home... I see!
records.en: Like it was welcoming you home... I see!

records.jp: ここにも作っちゃわない？^00商店街のゲート！
records.en_original: Why don't we make a shopping street sign here?
records.en: Why don't we make a shopping street sign here?

records.jp: 最近何か困ってることとかある？
records.en_original: Has anything been bothering you lately?
records.en: Has anything been bothering you lately?

records.jp: そうだなあ……^00最近、特に暑い日が続いてるじゃない？
records.en_original: Well... It doesn't seem like the heat's gonna be letting up anytime soon.
records.en: Well... It doesn't seem like the heat's gonna be letting up anytime soon.

records.jp: せっかくだから、何か夏らしいことがしたいな。^00例えば、みんなで花火とか！
records.en_original: I was thinking that we might do something summery. Like fireworks!
records.en: I was thinking that we might do something summery. Like fireworks!

records.jp: 花火！　いいねそれ、私もやりたい！
records.en_original: Fireworks! I like it! That would be a ton of fun!
records.en: Fireworks! I like it! That would be a ton of fun!

records.jp: やったあ！　じゃあ、さっそく作ってみようか
records.en_original: Yay! Let's try making some.
records.en: Yay! Let's try making some.

records.jp: えーっと、花火って^00火薬と一緒に何を燃やすかで、色が変わるんだよね
records.en_original: The stuff that's mixed with the gunpowder makes different colors, right?
records.en: The stuff that's mixed with the gunpowder makes different colors, right?

records.jp: そう、良く知ってるね
records.en_original: Yup, I'm surprised you know.
records.en: Yup, I'm surprised you know.

records.jp: ナトリウムと一緒に燃やせば黄色、銅なら緑。^00カルシウムならオレンジだったかな
records.en_original: I remember that sodium turns the fireworks yellow, copper turns them green, and calcium turns them orange.
records.en: I remember that sodium turns the fireworks yellow, copper turns them green, and calcium turns them orange.

records.jp: ナトリウムは塩でいいよね。^00銅は、銅線が工作室にあったはず。カルシウムは……
records.en_original: Salt should be good enough for the sodium. For copper, I think we had wires in the crafting room. The calcium on the other hand...
records.en: Salt should be good enough for the sodium. For copper, I think we had wires in the crafting room. The calcium on the other hand...

records.jp: カルシウムは、卵のカラでいいんじゃないかな。^00……ふふ、なんだか理科の実験みたいだね
records.en_original: I think eggshells should work. Hehe, this almost feels like a science experiment.
records.en: I think eggshells should work. Hehe, this almost feels like a science experiment.

records.jp: だね！　よーし、作るぞー！！
records.en_original: Totally! All right, let's put this stuff together!
records.en: Totally! All right, let's put this stuff together!

records.jp: 愛央、お願い！^00私に付き合って！
records.en_original: Ao! I need you, right now!
records.en: Ao! I need you, right now!

records.jp: 付き合って、って……そ、そんないきなり！？^00日菜子さんのことは大好きだけど、私……
records.en_original: N-need me?! Hinako, this is all so sudden... I mean, I like you too, but—
records.en: N-need me?! Hinako, this is all so sudden... I mean, I like you too, but—

records.jp: いやいや！^00私「と」付き合って、じゃないから
records.en_original: I didn't mean it like that!
records.en: I didn't mean it like that!

records.jp: 相手が愛央だとしても、もし告白するなら^00もうちょっとシチュエーションとか気を遣うよ
records.en_original: If I was gonna tell someone my feelings, I'd actually think about the time and the place. Even if it were someone like you.
records.en: If I was gonna tell someone my feelings, I'd actually think about the time and the place. Even if it were someone like you.

records.jp: あれ？　さりげなくディスられたような……^00じゃあ、何に付き合えばいいの？
records.en_original: Hm? You said that like a compliment, but... Anyway, what do you need me for?
records.en: Hm? You said that like a compliment, but... Anyway, what do you need me for?

records.jp: モンスターと戦うのに付き合ってほしいんだ。^00脚は問題なく動くんだけど、まだ違和感があって
records.en_original: I want you to come fight demons with me. My leg moves fine, but I still feel a little stiff.
records.en: I want you to come fight demons with me. My leg moves fine, but I still feel a little stiff.

records.jp: あ、そういうことね。^00りょうかーい！　さっそく行こうか！
records.en_original: Oh, I see now. All righty, then! Let's get to it!
records.en: Oh, I see now. All righty, then! Let's get to it!

records.jp: ふふ、ありがとう！^00愛央の切り替えの早いとこ、私好きだよ
records.en_original: Hehe, thank you! I love that part of you.
records.en: Hehe, thank you! I love that part of you.

records.jp: えっ、好き！？
records.en_original: Love?!
records.en: Love?!

records.jp: はいはい。じゃあ、行こうか
records.en_original: Okay, okay. It's time to go now.
records.en: Okay, okay. It's time to go now.

records.jp: ちょっといいかな？
records.en_original: Could I ask you something?
records.en: Could I ask you something?

records.jp: どしたの？
records.en_original: What's going on?
records.en: What's going on?

records.jp: 何事も備えが大切！　って^00宮内さんがよく言ってるけど……
records.en_original: Rena always says that we should be prepared for anything, but...
records.en: Rena always says that we should be prepared for anything, but...

records.jp: 備えようにも、^00物資を置くスペースが足りなくなってきたんだ
records.en_original: We've run out of space to put all the stuff we've prepared.
records.en: We've run out of space to put all the stuff we've prepared.

records.jp: ええっ、大変じゃん！
records.en_original: Oh no, really?
records.en: Oh no, really?

records.jp: ってことで、物資を収納できる場所が^00ほしいんだよね……
records.en_original: It'd be nice if we had somewhere to store all our resources...
records.en: It'd be nice if we had somewhere to store all our resources...

records.jp: それじゃあさ、コンテナとか作っちゃおうよ！^00体育館くらいおっきいの！
records.en_original: In that case, I'll make a storage container! It'll be as big as the gym!
records.en: In that case, I'll make a storage container! It'll be as big as the gym!

records.jp: それは……さすがに大きすぎかも
records.en_original: That might be a little too big...
records.en: That might be a little too big...

records.jp: いやいや、大は小を兼ねるっていうよ？
records.en_original: Nah, go big or go home, right?
records.en: Nah, go big or go home, right?

records.jp: よーし！　みんなが困んないくらい^00でっかいのを作っちゃおう！
records.en_original: All right! I'll make a container so big we won't have to worry anymore!
records.en: All right! I'll make a container so big we won't have to worry anymore!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、今ひまー？^00ちょっとおしゃべりしない？
records.en_original: Hiori, you busy right now? Wanna talk a bit?
records.en: Hiori, you busy right now? Wanna talk a bit?

records.jp: あ、そうだ。^00愛央ちゃんにお願いしたいことがあるんだけど
records.en_original: Oh, Ao. I actually wanted to ask you a favor.
records.en: Oh, Ao. I actually wanted to ask you a favor.

records.jp: お願い？^00なんだろ、私にできることかな
records.en_original: A favor? I'd be happy to help if I can.
records.en: A favor? I'd be happy to help if I can.

records.jp: ここでの戦いに慣れておきたくて……^00今度一緒に、モンスターと戦ってくれない？
records.en_original: I want to get more used to fighting here... Would you mind fighting some demons with me?
records.en: I want to get more used to fighting here... Would you mind fighting some demons with me?

records.jp: ああ、なるほど！^00そう言うことなら、喜んで！
records.en_original: Oh, okay! In that case, I'd be happy to help!
records.en: Oh, okay! In that case, I'd be happy to help!

records.jp: えへへ……ありがとう！^00愛央ちゃんなら、そう言ってくれると思ったんだ
records.en_original: Hehe, thanks! I was pretty sure that you'd agree.
records.en: Hehe, thanks! I was pretty sure that you'd agree.

records.jp: じゃあ、準備が出来たら一緒に行こうか
records.en_original: Let's head out there once we're ready.
records.en: Let's head out there once we're ready.

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: ちょっと相談したいことがあるんだけど、いいかな？
records.en_original: I wanna talk to you about something. Is now okay?
records.en: I wanna talk to you about something. Is now okay?

records.jp: どうしたの、陽桜莉さん
records.en_original: What's going on, Hiori?
records.en: What's going on, Hiori?

records.jp: 最近、お姉ちゃんが疲れてるみたいだから^00甘いものとか差し入れしたいなと思って
records.en_original: Mio has seemed a little tired recently, so I thought that I'd bring her something sweet for some energy.
records.en: Mio has seemed a little tired recently, so I thought that I'd bring her something sweet for some energy.

records.jp: 甘いものかあ……
records.en_original: Something sweet, huh...
records.en: Something sweet, huh...

records.jp: お菓子とか、飲み物とか、フルーツとか……^00何がいいのか悩んじゃってるんだよね
records.en_original: But there's many choices, I don't know what to go with. Candy, drinks, fruit...
records.en: But there's many choices, I don't know what to go with. Candy, drinks, fruit...

records.jp: 美弦さんって、どういうのが好きなの？
records.en_original: Well, what kind of stuff does she usually like?
records.en: Well, what kind of stuff does she usually like?

records.jp: それが……私もよく知らなくて。^00お姉ちゃん、あまり自分のこと話さないから
records.en_original: That's the thing... I don't really know either. She's almost never talks about herself.
records.en: That's the thing... I don't really know either. She's almost never talks about herself.

records.jp: あー……確かに。^00何かないか、私も探してみるよ
records.en_original: Ahh... Yeah, that's true. I'll see what I can find.
records.en: Ahh... Yeah, that's true. I'll see what I can find.

records.jp: ありがとう、愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao!
records.en: Thanks, Ao!

records.jp: ねえ、愛央ちゃんって縁日は好き？
records.en_original: Hey Ao, do you like temple festivals?
records.en: Hey Ao, do you like temple festivals?

records.jp: 好きだけど……どうして急に？
records.en_original: Yeah, I do. Why?
records.en: Yeah, I do. Why?

records.jp: 昨日ね、懐かしい夢を見たんだ
records.en_original: Last night, I had a dream that reminded me of a long time ago.
records.en: Last night, I had a dream that reminded me of a long time ago.

records.jp: お母さんとお姉ちゃんと三人で^00縁日に行く夢……
records.en_original: My mom, Mio, and I went to a festival together.
records.en: My mom, Mio, and I went to a festival together.

records.jp: 一度だけ、三人で行ったことがあるんだけど^00すっごく楽しかったんだよね
records.en_original: The three of us have only gone to one together once, but it was the best.
records.en: The three of us have only gone to one together once, but it was the best.

records.jp: ……だったらさ、ここにも縁日作らない？
records.en_original: ...So, should we have a festival here?
records.en: ...So, should we have a festival here?

records.jp: えっ、いいの？
records.en_original: Huh? Could we?
records.en: Huh? Could we?

records.jp: うん。きっとみんなも喜ぶよ！^00夏といえば、縁日だしね！
records.en_original: Yeah! Everyone would love it! Summer means festivals, after all!
records.en: Yeah! Everyone would love it! Summer means festivals, after all!

records.jp: わあ！　やったあ！
records.en_original: Oh, yaaaay!
records.en: Oh, yaaaay!

records.jp: でも、なんの屋台がいいかなあ……^00縁日って色々あるよね
records.en_original: What kind of stands should we have? There are all kinds at summer festivals.
records.en: What kind of stands should we have? There are all kinds at summer festivals.

records.jp: 私、金魚すくいがいいな！
records.en_original: We've gotta have goldfish scooping stands!
records.en: We've gotta have goldfish scooping stands!

records.jp: おっ、じゃあ決まり！
records.en_original: All right, it's decided!
records.en: All right, it's decided!

records.jp: えへへ……完成が楽しみ！
records.en_original: Hehe! I can't wait to see it when it's done!
records.en: Hehe! I can't wait to see it when it's done!

records.jp: ねえ、愛央ちゃん。アクセサリーの材料になりそうな^00素材とかって知らない？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao? Do you know of any materials that would be good for making accessories?
records.en: Hey, Ao? Do you know of any materials that would be good for making accessories?

records.jp: アクセサリー？　何か作るの？
records.en_original: Accessories? You're gonna make one yourself?
records.en: Accessories? You're gonna make one yourself?

records.jp: うん。お守り代わりに^00お姉ちゃんに、渡そうかなーって
records.en_original: Mmhm. I was thinking of giving something to Mio as a good luck charm.
records.en: Mmhm. I was thinking of giving something to Mio as a good luck charm.

records.jp: お姉ちゃん、一人で無茶することもあるし……^00私も、ずっと側にいられるわけじゃないから
records.en_original: She's always putting herself in danger, and as much as I might like to, I can't be with her all the time.
records.en: She's always putting herself in danger, and as much as I might like to, I can't be with her all the time.

records.jp: うーん……^00アクセサリーの材料になりそうな素材かあ
records.en_original: Let's see... Something that could be used to make an accessory...
records.en: Let's see... Something that could be used to make an accessory...

records.jp: ……あっ！^00あの、モンスターの素材とかいいかも！
records.en_original: Oh! What about materials from a demon?
records.en: Oh! What about materials from a demon?

records.jp: モンスターの素材なら、倒しに行かないと
records.en_original: Guess I'm going demon hunting then.
records.en: Guess I'm going demon hunting then.

records.jp: 私も手伝うよ。一緒に集めたほうが早いしね
records.en_original: I'll come along. It'll be faster with the two of us.
records.en: I'll come along. It'll be faster with the two of us.

records.jp: わあ、ありがとう愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao!
records.en: Thanks, Ao!

records.jp: 今日も暑いねえ
records.en_original: It's so hot out today...
records.en: It's so hot out today...

records.jp: 毎日毎日、変わらずに夏だもんねえ。^00シャワーでも浴びて、サッパリしたいなあ
records.en_original: Every day feels like summer here. I could really go for a nice, cold shower right about now...
records.en: Every day feels like summer here. I could really go for a nice, cold shower right about now...

records.jp: ……あっ、それいいかも！^00屋外用シャワー作ろうよ
records.en_original: Oh, that sounds amazing! Let's make an outdoor shower!
records.en: Oh, that sounds amazing! Let's make an outdoor shower!

records.jp: おお！　ナイスアイディア！
records.en_original: Ooh! Great idea!
records.en: Ooh! Great idea!

records.jp: 水着をきれば、みんなで水浴びも出来るよね！
records.en_original: We can all wear our swimsuits and splash around together!
records.en: We can all wear our swimsuits and splash around together!

records.jp: うんうん！　そのまま、花壇に水もまけるし！
records.en_original: Yeah! We could even use it to water the flowers too!
records.en: Yeah! We could even use it to water the flowers too!

records.jp: わっ、ほんとだ！　便利！
records.en_original: Oh, you're right! It'd be so useful!
records.en: Oh, you're right! It'd be so useful!

records.jp: ……いや、今のは冗談だよ？
records.en_original: ...That was a joke.
records.en: ...That was a joke.

records.jp: えっ、そうなの？
records.en_original: Wait, really?
records.en: Wait, really?

records.jp: なんか、夏っぽいことしたいなー
records.en_original: I wanna do something really summery...
records.en: I wanna do something really summery...

records.jp: 夏っぽいことかあ……プールで泳ぐとか？
records.en_original: Summery... You mean like, swimming in a pool?
records.en: Summery... You mean like, swimming in a pool?

records.jp: うーん、なんか違う
records.en_original: No, that's not quite it.
records.en: No, that's not quite it.

records.jp: アイス食べるとか？
records.en_original: Eating ice cream?
records.en: Eating ice cream?

records.jp: アイスは年中無休で美味しい
records.en_original: Ice cream is good 24/7/365.
records.en: Ice cream is good 24/7/365.

records.jp: ……あ、キャンプはどう？^00外で、まったり過ごすのも楽しそうじゃない？
records.en_original: Oh, what about camping? Enjoying the great outdoors sounds like fun.
records.en: Oh, what about camping? Enjoying the great outdoors sounds like fun.

records.jp: 外でお茶飲んだり、バーベキューしたり……、^00あと、チェアーに座って、まったりしたりするの
records.en_original: Sipping some tea, having a barbecue, kicking back and relaxing in some lounge chairs...
records.en: Sipping some tea, having a barbecue, kicking back and relaxing in some lounge chairs...

records.jp: おお、それいいかも！！
records.en_original: Ooh, I like that idea!
records.en: Ooh, I like that idea!

records.jp: みんなでキャンプしたら、絶対楽しいよね
records.en_original: It'd be so fun if we all went camping together!
records.en: It'd be so fun if we all went camping together!

records.jp: じゃあ、さっそくキャンプ場を作ろう！
records.en_original: Then I'll get started on making a campsite!
records.en: Then I'll get started on making a campsite!

records.jp: ねー愛央、ちょっと来てー
records.en_original: Hey, Ao, over here.
records.en: Hey, Ao, over here.

records.jp: え、なになに？
records.en_original: Huh? What's up?
records.en: Huh? What's up?

records.jp: うーん……そろそろうずいてきたなぁ
records.en_original: Uggghh... It hurts, Ao. I'm in pain!
records.en: Uggghh... It hurts, Ao. I'm in pain!

records.jp: おっ。それなりに嫌な予感。^00一応聞くけど、何がうずいてきたの？
records.en_original: Oh? That doesn't sound good. Okay, I'll bite. What hurts?
records.en: Oh? That doesn't sound good. Okay, I'll bite. What hurts?

records.jp: 芸術魂？^00今回はねー、夏らしい写真を撮りたいなって！
records.en_original: My artistic soul! I wanna take some summery pictures, but...
records.en: My artistic soul! I wanna take some summery pictures, but...

records.jp: でも、夏らしいだけじゃつまんないから……^00可愛くて、映えて、おいしいやつを撮りたい！
records.en_original: "Summery" itself is not enough. I want to take the cutest, sweetest, most aesthetic pics!
records.en: "Summery" itself is not enough. I want to take the cutest, sweetest, most aesthetic pics!

records.jp: 思ったよりまともだった。^00てか、むしろそれいいね！　私もやりたい！
records.en_original: I should've known it wasn't anything serious. But that sounds great! I wanna do that too!
records.en: I should've known it wasn't anything serious. But that sounds great! I wanna do that too!

records.jp: さっすが愛央、そうこなくちゃ！^00実はね、もう目星はつけてあるんだ
records.en_original: That's my girl! Y'know, I already have my subject picked out!
records.en: That's my girl! Y'know, I already have my subject picked out!

records.jp: 夏といえば……夏祭り！^00で、夏祭りの可愛いアイテムといえば、りんご飴！
records.en_original: Summer equals summer festivals, which equals the adorable candy apple!
records.en: Summer equals summer festivals, which equals the adorable candy apple!

records.jp: いいねいいね！　なんかやる気出てきたぞ！^00こうなったら気合入れて屋台から作っちゃいますか！
records.en_original: That sounds perfect! I'm getting excited! I should make you a food stall while I'm all pumped up!
records.en: That sounds perfect! I'm getting excited! I should make you a food stall while I'm all pumped up!

records.jp: んー……。あのさ、愛央。^00実はちょっと欲しいものがあるんだけど……
records.en_original: Um, Ao? Truth is, there's something I'd like you to get for me.
records.en: Um, Ao? Truth is, there's something I'd like you to get for me.

records.jp: 創作意欲が湧いたのか、イタズラの方か……。^00それで、何が欲しいの？
records.en_original: Is this for a creative project or another prank...? What is it you need?
records.en: Is this for a creative project or another prank...? What is it you need?

records.jp: えっとね。スタンガン
records.en_original: Well. I would like for you to procure for me, a stun gun.
records.en: Well. I would like for you to procure for me, a stun gun.

records.jp: スタンガン……！？　いやダメだって！^00いくらなんでもイタズラでそんな物を使うのは……
records.en_original: A what?! No way! I know it might sound like it would make for a good prank, but—
records.en: A what?! No way! I know it might sound like it would make for a good prank, but—

records.jp: ちょっと、愛央。さすがにあたしだって、^00イタズラ目的でスタンガンなんか欲しがらないって
records.en_original: Ao, calm down. Even I wouldn't consider using a stun gun for a prank.
records.en: Ao, calm down. Even I wouldn't consider using a stun gun for a prank.

records.jp: あくまで護身用。探索中にだけ持つつもり。^00……ほら、あたしはみんなみたいに戦えないからさ
records.en_original: It's for self defense. I'd only take it during explorations. Because, you know, I can't fight...
records.en: It's for self defense. I'd only take it during explorations. Because, you know, I can't fight...

records.jp: 探索中にみんなの足を引っぱらないためにも、^00いざって時のために備えておきたいなーって
records.en_original: I want to be prepared, just in case, so that I won't weigh everyone down while we're out there.
records.en: I want to be prepared, just in case, so that I won't weigh everyone down while we're out there.

records.jp: そういうことか……。でも……うーん……。^00スタンガンがあってもなくても危ないような……
records.en_original: So that's why... I see where you're coming from, but... I think it'll be dangerous out there regardless if you have it or not.
records.en: So that's why... I see where you're coming from, but... I think it'll be dangerous out there regardless if you have it or not.

records.jp: そう言わずに！　お願い、愛央。手伝って！^00あたしなりに頑張って考えたんだよ
records.en_original: Don't say that! Please, Ao? Help me out! I've thought about this a lot.
records.en: Don't say that! Please, Ao? Help me out! I've thought about this a lot.

records.jp: うう……そう言われると……。^00わかった、手伝うよ
records.en_original: Guh, if you say so... Okay, I'll help you.
records.en: Guh, if you say so... Okay, I'll help you.

records.jp: ううむ……
records.en_original: Hrm...
records.en: Hrm...

records.jp: どうしたの、きらら。^00なんか、悩みごと?
records.en_original: What's wrong, Kirara? Something on your mind?
records.en: What's wrong, Kirara? Something on your mind?

records.en_original: Water...
records.en: Water...

records.jp: えっ、水?
records.en_original: Huh? Water?
records.en: Huh? Water?

records.jp: 水が、きららを呼んでる。^00水がある場所にいかなければ……
records.en_original: Water is calling to me. I must go where there is water.
records.en: Water is calling to me. I must go where there is water.

records.jp: それってもしかして、神様のお告げ？
records.en_original: A prophecy from the Divine?
records.en: A prophecy from the Divine?

records.jp: 分からない。^00だが、脳裏にふっと浮かんだのだ
records.en_original: I don't know... It appeared suddenly in my mind.
records.en: I don't know... It appeared suddenly in my mind.

records.jp: 四角い……四角い水……
records.en_original: I saw a rectangle... Rectangular water...
records.en: I saw a rectangle... Rectangular water...

records.jp: ……四角い水かあ
records.en_original: Rectangular water?
records.en: Rectangular water?

records.jp: 愛央、分かる？
records.en_original: You know what it is, Ao?
records.en: You know what it is, Ao?

records.jp: うーん、考えてみるよ
records.en_original: Hmm... I'll take some time to think about it.
records.en: Hmm... I'll take some time to think about it.

records.jp: 愛央、このままだと^00きららたちの身に良くないことが起きる
records.en_original: Ao, something terrible will happen in the near future if nothing changes.
records.en: Ao, something terrible will happen in the near future if nothing changes.

records.jp: えっ、いきなりどうしたの！？
records.en_original: What's all this all of a sudden?!
records.en: What's all this all of a sudden?!

records.jp: 愛央も知ってるモンスター……^00なるべく早く、あいつを倒してほしい
records.en_original: I need you to defeat a certain demon for me as soon as possible. I'm sure you've seen it before.
records.en: I need you to defeat a certain demon for me as soon as possible. I'm sure you've seen it before.

records.jp: それって、もしかして神のお告げ……？
records.en_original: Is this another one of your prophecies?
records.en: Is this another one of your prophecies?

records.jp: いや、きららの直感だ
records.en_original: No, just simple instinct.
records.en: No, just simple instinct.

records.jp: きららの直感かあ……
records.en_original: Instinct, huh...
records.en: Instinct, huh...

records.jp: でも、直感ってあたることもあるしね。^00わかった、そのモンスター倒してくるよ！
records.en_original: Well, better to take care of it than to ignore it. I'll go take care of that demon!
records.en: Well, better to take care of it than to ignore it. I'll go take care of that demon!

records.jp: うん、頼んだ
records.en_original: Good luck.
records.en: Good luck.

records.jp: 愛央……お願いがあるのだが
records.en_original: Ao... I have a favor to ask.
records.en: Ao... I have a favor to ask.

records.jp: きららからのお願いって珍しいね。なにー？
records.en_original: It's not often I hear you ask for anything, Kirara. What is it?
records.en: It's not often I hear you ask for anything, Kirara. What is it?

records.jp: ココロトープから、怪しい気配を感じる。^00何か、よからぬことが起きているのでは……
records.en_original: I sense a strange energy coming from the Heartscapes. I think something terrible may be happening...
records.en: I sense a strange energy coming from the Heartscapes. I think something terrible may be happening...

records.jp: マジで！？　それ、やばいやつじゃん！
records.en_original: Seriously?! That sounds really bad!
records.en: Seriously?! That sounds really bad!

records.jp: だから、調べに行ってほしい。^00きららは……戦えないから
records.en_original: I'd like you to go and take a look since I am...unable to fight.
records.en: I'd like you to go and take a look since I am...unable to fight.

records.jp: 大丈夫、私に任せといて！
records.en_original: Don't worry, you can leave it to me!
records.en: Don't worry, you can leave it to me!

records.jp: うむ、さすがはリーダー。^00心強い言葉だ
records.en_original: I knew I could count on you.
records.en: I knew I could count on you.

records.jp: そういえば……^00ここにはアレがないな
records.en_original: You know... There aren't any of those here.
records.en: You know... There aren't any of those here.

records.jp: あれって？
records.en_original: Those what?
records.en: Those what?

records.jp: お社だ
records.en_original: Shrines.
records.en: Shrines.

records.jp: おやしろ？^00……あ、神様を祀る場所のことか
records.en_original: Like, Shinto shrines? Places to pray to the gods and whatnot?
records.en: Like, Shinto shrines? Places to pray to the gods and whatnot?

records.jp: そう。ここには神がいないから、当然だけど
records.en_original: Yeah. Though I suppose it's natural since there aren't any gods here.
records.en: Yeah. Though I suppose it's natural since there aren't any gods here.

records.jp: んー……だったら、つくっちゃう？
records.en_original: Then...how about we make one?
records.en: Then...how about we make one?

records.jp: あ、でも……勝手につくったら^00神様怒ったりすんのかな？
records.en_original: Oh, but... Doing something like that might anger the gods.
records.en: Oh, but... Doing something like that might anger the gods.

records.jp: それはないと思う。^00家があると、神も喜ぶ
records.en_original: I don't think so. As long as they have a proper dwelling, they'll be pleased.
records.en: I don't think so. As long as they have a proper dwelling, they'll be pleased.

records.jp: んじゃ、つくってみようよ！　もしかしたら^00神様の声が、聞こえるようになるかもよ？
records.en_original: Great! Let's get to building then! If there are any gods around, maybe you'll be able to hear them.
records.en: Great! Let's get to building then! If there are any gods around, maybe you'll be able to hear them.

records.jp: ……なるほど。^00試してみる価値はありそうだ
records.en_original: Good point. That's reason enough to try.
records.en: Good point. That's reason enough to try.

records.jp: 頼んだぞ、愛央
records.en_original: I appreciate it, Ao.
records.en: I appreciate it, Ao.

records.jp: まっかせといて！！
records.en_original: Leave it to me!
records.en: Leave it to me!

records.jp: むう……眠い……
records.en_original: Hmmph... So sleepy...
records.en: Hmmph... So sleepy...

records.jp: きらら、最近あんまり眠れてないの？
records.en_original: Have you not been sleeping well lately, Kirara?
records.en: Have you not been sleeping well lately, Kirara?

records.jp: うん。毎晩、同じ夢を見ている……^00黒い影が数体……きららを追いかけてくる
records.en_original: Indeed. Lately, I've been seeing the same dream every night. Innumerous shadows chase me...
records.en: Indeed. Lately, I've been seeing the same dream every night. Innumerous shadows chase me...

records.jp: あれはきっと、前に見たモンスターだと思う
records.en_original: I believe they are the demons we saw.
records.en: I believe they are the demons we saw.

records.jp: 黒い影って前にも言ってたよね。^00何かが、きららの精神に影響してるのかな？
records.en_original: You mentioned shadows last time too. Maybe something is affecting your mind?
records.en: You mentioned shadows last time too. Maybe something is affecting your mind?

records.jp: その可能性はある。^00ココロトープは精神の影響を受けるからな
records.en_original: That is a possibility. The Heartscapes do have an effect on their owner's psyche.
records.en: That is a possibility. The Heartscapes do have an effect on their owner's psyche.

records.jp: このままにしておくのも心配だし^00そのモンスター倒してくるよ
records.en_original: I think it would be better if I took care of that demon sooner rather than later.
records.en: I think it would be better if I took care of that demon sooner rather than later.

records.jp: 助かる……あ、もうまぶたが……
records.en_original: That would be of great help. Ah, I can't keep my eyes open...
records.en: That would be of great help. Ah, I can't keep my eyes open...

records.jp: 愛央、頼みたいことがある
records.en_original: Ao. Could I make a request?
records.en: Ao. Could I make a request?

records.jp: おっ、なになに？^00きららからのお願いって、珍しいね
records.en_original: Ooh, what is it? It's not often that you ask for something, Kirara.
records.en: Ooh, what is it? It's not often that you ask for something, Kirara.

records.jp: 丸くて穴の空いてるものをつくってほしい
records.en_original: I would like you to make something round with an empty hole.
records.en: I would like you to make something round with an empty hole.

records.jp: ……ええと、ドーナツかな？
records.en_original: Umm... Like a donut?
records.en: Umm... Like a donut?

records.jp: ちがう。たぶん、水に関係するものだ
records.en_original: No. Something related to water.
records.en: No. Something related to water.
