records.jp: 丸くて穴が空いてて、水…………
records.en_original: So...something round with an empty hole that's related to water...
records.en: So...something round with an empty hole that's related to water...

records.jp: あっ！？　もしかして、井戸！？
records.en_original: Oh! You mean, a well?!
records.en: Oh! You mean, a well?!

records.jp: ふむ、なるほど。^00井戸なら、条件は満たしているな
records.en_original: Hmm, interesting. A well would meet those conditions.
records.en: Hmm, interesting. A well would meet those conditions.

records.jp: なるほどって……^00きららがつくってほしいんじゃないの？
records.en_original: Interesting? Aren't you the one who asked me to build it for you?
records.en: Interesting? Aren't you the one who asked me to build it for you?

records.jp: 昨日、突然閃いたのだ。^00この世界には、丸くて穴の空いたものが必要だと
records.en_original: Last night, I had a revelation. This world needs something round with an empty hole.
records.en: Last night, I had a revelation. This world needs something round with an empty hole.

records.jp: 井戸って、突然閃くもんなの！？
records.en_original: Is a well really something to have a revelation about?
records.en: Is a well really something to have a revelation about?

records.jp: でも、確かに井戸があると水には困らないし。^00つくってみようかなあ……
records.en_original: If we did have a well, we wouldn't have to worry about water anymore. Maybe I will make one...
records.en: If we did have a well, we wouldn't have to worry about water anymore. Maybe I will make one...

records.jp: そういえば、愛央におすすめしたい本がある
records.en_original: By the way, there's a book I want to recommend to you, Ao.
records.en: By the way, there's a book I want to recommend to you, Ao.

records.jp: え、なんてタイトル？
records.en_original: Oh? What's it called?
records.en: Oh? What's it called?

records.jp: 『現世でモテモテだった俺が異世界では奴隷です』。^00きららコレクションの中でも、名作中の名作だぞ
records.en_original: I Used to Be a Hunk, but I'm a Slave in Another World. It's the best of the best in my collection.
records.en: I Used to Be a Hunk, but I'm a Slave in Another World. It's the best of the best in my collection.

records.jp: あっ、それ私も好き！　漫画化も映画化も^00されてるんだよね！
records.en_original: Ah! I love that one too! They also made a manga and movie version of it, right?
records.en: Ah! I love that one too! They also made a manga and movie version of it, right?

records.jp: そう。その映画のDVDがここに……^00しかし映画を見るためには、シアターが必要……
records.en_original: Correct. There is a DVD copy of the movie here, but we don't have a theater to watch it in...
records.en: Correct. There is a DVD copy of the movie here, but we don't have a theater to watch it in...

records.jp: あ、なるほど。理解した。^00つまりきららは、シアタールームがほしいと
records.en_original: Ah, gotcha. So what you're saying is that you want a theater.
records.en: Ah, gotcha. So what you're saying is that you want a theater.

records.jp: そういうことだな
records.en_original: Precisely.
records.en: Precisely.

records.jp: 分かった、私に任せて！^00てか、私もその映画見たいし！
records.en_original: Roger that. Leave it to me! I wanna watch that movie too!
records.en: Roger that. Leave it to me! I wanna watch that movie too!

records.jp: うむ。頼んだぞ、愛央
records.en_original: Heh. Godspeed, Ao.
records.en: Heh. Godspeed, Ao.

records.jp: 分かった。^00んじゃ、つくってみるよ！
records.en_original: Thanks! I'll get to work!
records.en: Thanks! I'll get to work!

records.jp: 美弦さん、今ひまー？
records.en_original: Mio, are you free?
records.en: Mio, are you free?

records.jp: 美弦さん、何か困ったことでもあったの？
records.en_original: Is something bothering you, Mio?
records.en: Is something bothering you, Mio?

records.jp: あ、愛央、ごめんなさい。^00ちょっと考え事をしてて……気が付かなかったわ
records.en_original: Ah... Ao, I'm sorry. I had something on my mind. I didn't notice.
records.en: Ah... Ao, I'm sorry. I had something on my mind. I didn't notice.

records.jp: 美弦さん、いっつもみんなのこと心配して、^00気配りしてるもんね
records.en_original: You're always so worried about taking care of all of us, you should worry more about yourself.
records.en: You're always so worried about taking care of all of us, you should worry more about yourself.

records.jp: そんなに褒められたものではないけれど、^00……そうね。少しはリラックスしないとね
records.en_original: I don't think I would go so far as to say that, but... I suppose I could do with a little more relaxation.
records.en: I don't think I would go so far as to say that, but... I suppose I could do with a little more relaxation.

records.jp: リラックスかぁ……
records.en_original: Relaxation, huh...
records.en: Relaxation, huh...

records.jp: あ、それならあそこがいいかも！
records.en_original: I think I have the perfect place for that!
records.en: I think I have the perfect place for that!

records.jp: ……困った
records.en_original: This is terrible...
records.en: This is terrible...

records.jp: ん？　美弦さん、どしたの？^00なんか困りごと？
records.en_original: Hm? What's wrong, Mio? Do you have a problem?
records.en: Hm? What's wrong, Mio? Do you have a problem?

records.jp: 陽桜莉のリクエストでカレーを作りたいのだけど、^00材料が少し足りなくて……
records.en_original: Hiori wanted some curry for dinner tonight, but I'm missing a few ingredients.
records.en: Hiori wanted some curry for dinner tonight, but I'm missing a few ingredients.

records.jp: カレーの材料かぁ……。^00詩帆さんたちが切らしてるなんて、珍しいね
records.en_original: Ingredients for curry, huh. It's kind of rare for Shiho to not have any in stock.
records.en: Ingredients for curry, huh. It's kind of rare for Shiho to not have any in stock.

records.jp: まったく、間が悪いものね
records.en_original: Just terrible timing it seems.
records.en: Just terrible timing it seems.

records.jp: ……カレーはともかく、食材が切れていると^00食生活が貧しくなりそうね、愛央
records.en_original: Curry aside, without those ingredients, we'll have to cut back on what we use in our meals.
records.en: Curry aside, without those ingredients, we'll have to cut back on what we use in our meals.

records.jp: ……食材の調達、頼まれてもらえないかしら？
records.en_original: Would you be willing to gather some supplies for us?
records.en: Would you be willing to gather some supplies for us?

records.jp: う……途中からそんなことじゃないかと……。^00分かったよ。早めに調達してくるねー
records.en_original: I had a feeling that's where this was going... Okay, I'll go get them as soon as possible.
records.en: I had a feeling that's where this was going... Okay, I'll go get them as soon as possible.

records.jp: 愛央は、この世界が水に囲まれてて、^00寂しく思うことはない？
records.en_original: Oasis is completely surrounded by water. Don't you think that feels rather lonely, Ao?
records.en: Oasis is completely surrounded by water. Don't you think that feels rather lonely, Ao?

records.jp: んー。どっちかっていうと、慣れちゃったかなぁ。^00むしろ、水の向こうに何かあったらびっくり的な？
records.en_original: Hmm... I think I'm used to it at this point. I'd be surprised if there was something out there.
records.en: Hmm... I think I'm used to it at this point. I'd be surprised if there was something out there.

records.jp: ふふ。愛央らしいといえば、らしい答えね
records.en_original: Hehe. That sounds like something you would say.
records.en: Hehe. That sounds like something you would say.

records.jp: え、どーいう意味で！？
records.en_original: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?!
records.en: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?!

records.jp: 陽桜莉がときどき、寂しそうな顔で^00遠くの方を見つめているの
records.en_original: Sometimes Hiori looks out over the sea with this sad expression on her face...
records.en: Sometimes Hiori looks out over the sea with this sad expression on her face...

records.jp: だから……嘘……ただの気休めでもいい。^00あの子に、世界は広いことを思い出させてあげたい
records.en_original: So... even if it's a lie, or just an empty promise, I want to remind her just how vast the world is.
records.en: So... even if it's a lie, or just an empty promise, I want to remind her just how vast the world is.

records.jp: 世界は広い、かぁ……あ！^00空の上には宇宙が広がってるかも、とか！
records.en_original: How vast the world is... Oh, we could tell her that outer space might exist in this world too?
records.en: How vast the world is... Oh, we could tell her that outer space might exist in this world too?

records.jp: 宇宙……そうね。星空は見えるのだから、^00あながち嘘とは限らない
records.en_original: Outer space... Yes. We can see the stars, so it wouldn't be a complete lie.
records.en: Outer space... Yes. We can see the stars, so it wouldn't be a complete lie.

records.jp: でしょでしょ！^00でも、陽桜莉さん、どうしたら喜んでくれるかなぁ
records.en_original: Exactly! But I wonder how we could use that to cheer Hiori up...
records.en: Exactly! But I wonder how we could use that to cheer Hiori up...

records.jp: そうね……いきなり宇宙船、というのは突飛だし、^00宇宙服を着るだけでも、気分は変わると思う
records.en_original: Hmm... A spaceship might be extreme, but maybe trying on a space suit would change her mood?
records.en: Hmm... A spaceship might be extreme, but maybe trying on a space suit would change her mood?

records.jp: 宇宙服かぁ……私も着てみたいかも！^00それじゃ、宇宙服を作ってみよー！
records.en_original: A space suit! I'd love to try one on, too. I'll start working on it!
records.en: A space suit! I'd love to try one on, too. I'll start working on it!

records.jp: 愛央、少し相談があるのだけど
records.en_original: Ao, there's something I'd like to discuss with you.
records.en: Ao, there's something I'd like to discuss with you.

records.jp: え、どうしたの、美弦さん？
records.en_original: What's up, Mio?
records.en: What's up, Mio?

records.jp: ここでの生活が、どれだけ続くか分からない。^00でも、そうとなると……
records.en_original: We don't know how long we'll have to live here. But, you see, that would mean...
records.en: We don't know how long we'll have to live here. But, you see, that would mean...

records.jp: そ、そうとなると……？
records.en_original: That would mean...?
records.en: That would mean...?

records.jp: 元の世界に戻った時に、陽桜莉がすっかり^00学んだことを忘れてしまっているかもしれない
records.en_original: By that time, Hiori may have forgotten everything she learned in school.
records.en: By that time, Hiori may have forgotten everything she learned in school.

records.jp: だから、陽桜莉に勉強を教えようと思うの。^00何か使えそうなものはないかしら？
records.en_original: That's why I've been thinking about teaching her. Do you know if there are any materials I may be able to use?
records.en: That's why I've been thinking about teaching her. Do you know if there are any materials I may be able to use?

records.jp: うーん、勉強かあ……。^00そういうのはちょっとさっぱりかな……
records.en_original: Teaching, huh... I have no clue about that kind of stuff.
records.en: Teaching, huh... I have no clue about that kind of stuff.

records.jp: 難しく考えなくていいわ。^00この世界のもので、実験するのだって勉強よ
records.en_original: It doesn't have to be something complex. You could just experiment around in this world or something.
records.en: It doesn't have to be something complex. You could just experiment around in this world or something.

records.jp: 実験……！^00それならちょっと面白そうかも！
records.en_original: Experiments...! That actually sounds like fun!
records.en: Experiments...! That actually sounds like fun!

records.jp: 何か使えそうなもの、探してみるね！
records.en_original: I'll try looking for something you might be able to use!
records.en: I'll try looking for something you might be able to use!

records.jp: ねえ、愛央。^00ひとつ、お願いがあるのだけど……
records.en_original: Ao, I have a favor to ask of you...
records.en: Ao, I have a favor to ask of you...

records.jp: えっ、美弦さんが私にお願い？^00何だろ？　私にできることかな？
records.en_original: You need a favor from me? I hope I can help!
records.en: You need a favor from me? I hope I can help!

records.jp: ……実はこの間、陽桜莉がココロトープで^00きれいな石を見つけたって、見せてくれたの
records.en_original: You see, Hiori showed me this beautiful stone she found in the Heartscape the other day.
records.en: You see, Hiori showed me this beautiful stone she found in the Heartscape the other day.

records.jp: 私もその石が欲しいと思ったのだけど、^00私は戦えないから……
records.en_original: I wanted one for myself too, but I can't fight, so...
records.en: I wanted one for myself too, but I can't fight, so...

records.jp: あ！　えへへ。わかったー！^00実は、陽桜莉さんにプレゼントしたいんでしょ？
records.en_original: Oh! Hehehe. I get it now! You want to gift it to Hiori, don't you?
records.en: Oh! Hehehe. I get it now! You want to gift it to Hiori, don't you?

records.jp: え？　た、たしかにあの子、^00もっと集めたいとは言ってたけれど……
records.en_original: What? W-well, she did say she wanted to collect more, but...
records.en: What? W-well, she did say she wanted to collect more, but...

records.jp: 照れなくてもいーって！^00私が代わりに探してきてあげる！
records.en_original: Aw, don't be embarrassed! Don't worry, I'll go find some for you!
records.en: Aw, don't be embarrassed! Don't worry, I'll go find some for you!

records.jp: 夏っていうと、やっぱでっかいプールだよね～。^00みんなで遊園地で騒ぎたいなぁー
records.en_original: What's summer without a swimming pool? I wanna go to an amusement park with everyone too...
records.en: What's summer without a swimming pool? I wanna go to an amusement park with everyone too...

records.jp: 遊園地ね……
records.en_original: An amusement park...
records.en: An amusement park...

records.jp: ……まだ幼い頃に一度だけ、両親に連れられて^00行ったことがあったわ
records.en_original: Once, when we were young, my parents took us to an amusement park.
records.en: Once, when we were young, my parents took us to an amusement park.

records.jp: そうなんだ……！　陽桜莉さんも一緒に？
records.en_original: I see... With Hiori too?
records.en: I see... With Hiori too?

records.jp: ええ。陽桜莉は、動物の乗り物がお気に入りで、^00「もう一回」って、何度もせがまれたものよ
records.en_original: Yes. She loved the animal rides so much. She kept begging for another round on them.
records.en: Yes. She loved the animal rides so much. She kept begging for another round on them.

records.jp: その時の美弦さんと陽桜莉さん、^00可愛かっただろうなぁ……見たかったぁ
records.en_original: I bet you two were the cutest things ever back then. I wish I could've seen...
records.en: I bet you two were the cutest things ever back then. I wish I could've seen...

records.jp: 私はともかく、あの子の屈託のない笑顔は^00ずっと心に焼き付いているわ
records.en_original: The carefree smile on Hiori's face that day was etched into my memory from then on.
records.en: The carefree smile on Hiori's face that day was etched into my memory from then on.

records.jp: へえ～
records.en_original: Hmmm...
records.en: Hmmm...

records.jp: それじゃ、ここに作っちゃおうよ！^00遊園地の動物の乗り物！
records.en_original: Well then, I'll just have to make an animal ride like that here!
records.en: Well then, I'll just have to make an animal ride like that here!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、絶対に喜ぶよ！
records.en_original: I'm sure Hiori would love it!
records.en: I'm sure Hiori would love it!

records.jp: ……ふと思ったのだけど
records.en_original: ...I just had a thought.
records.en: ...I just had a thought.

records.jp: 外の世界には無が広がっているのだとすれば、^00今見えている空はつくり物ということよね
records.en_original: If there is only nothingness outside this world, that means the sky we're looking at now is fake.
records.en: If there is only nothingness outside this world, that means the sky we're looking at now is fake.

records.jp: あー……そうなのかも？
records.en_original: Ah... Yeah, maybe.
records.en: Ah... Yeah, maybe.

records.jp: ということは、夜の星空もつくり物……。^00すごいわね、どんなプラネタリウムより綺麗
records.en_original: That would also mean that someone created these stars. That's amazing. It's prettier than any planetarium I've ever seen.
records.en: That would also mean that someone created these stars. That's amazing. It's prettier than any planetarium I've ever seen.

records.jp: もしかして……美弦さん、星が好きなの？
records.en_original: Do you like stars, Mio?
records.en: Do you like stars, Mio?

records.jp: ええ。昔からキラキラしたものが好きで……
records.en_original: Yes. I've always loved things that sparkle.
records.en: Yes. I've always loved things that sparkle.

records.jp: 小さい頃は、宇宙飛行士になって^00星を取りに行きたいと思っていたものよ
records.en_original: When I was little, I wanted to become an astronaut so I could collect the stars.
records.en: When I was little, I wanted to become an astronaut so I could collect the stars.

records.jp: なるほど……じゃあ、取りに行ってみようよ
records.en_original: I see... Well then, let's go get them!
records.en: I see... Well then, let's go get them!

records.jp: え？　取りに行くって……
records.en_original: Huh? Go get them...?
records.en: Huh? Go get them...?

records.jp: 雫世界の星なら、きっと本当の宇宙よりも^00近いところにあるはず
records.en_original: There's no way the stars of Oasis are as far away as the stars in our world.
records.en: There's no way the stars of Oasis are as far away as the stars in our world.

records.jp: ひとっ飛びして取りに行こう！
records.en_original: So we can just fly up and get them!
records.en: So we can just fly up and get them!

records.jp: ええ！？
records.en_original: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: 星崎さん。^00お願いがあるのですが、いま大丈夫ですか？
records.en_original: Ao. I have a favor to ask. Do you have a moment to talk?
records.en: Ao. I have a favor to ask. Do you have a moment to talk?

records.jp: うん。お願いってなに？
records.en_original: Sure. What's up?
records.en: Sure. What's up?

records.jp: 花壇に水をあげていたら、かなりいろいろな草が^00生えてきたことに気付いたんです
records.en_original: I've been watering the garden, and I've noticed that a large amount of plants have begun to grow.
records.en: I've been watering the garden, and I've noticed that a large amount of plants have begun to grow.

records.jp: でも、植物には詳しくないので、どれを雑草として^00取り除くべきか、よく分からなくて……
records.en_original: But, you see, I don't know much about plants, so I'm not sure which are weeds...
records.en: But, you see, I don't know much about plants, so I'm not sure which are weeds...

records.jp: 私だったら、適当に抜いちゃう気がするけど、^00詩さんってきっちりしてるなぁ……
records.en_original: If it were me I'd probably just pull out stuff randomly... You sure are diligent about this kind of stuff.
records.en: If it were me I'd probably just pull out stuff randomly... You sure are diligent about this kind of stuff.

records.jp: いえ。もしどなたかが植えたものだったり、害の^00ない草だったりしたら、大変ですから
records.en_original: No, it's just I'd feel terrible if I took something out that wasn't a weed.
records.en: No, it's just I'd feel terrible if I took something out that wasn't a weed.

records.jp: しかも、思いやりだった！？
records.en_original: Oh, so you were being considerate!
records.en: Oh, so you were being considerate!

records.jp: 思いやりになっているかは分かりませんが……^00草について、どう見分ければ良いでしょうか？
records.en_original: I'm not sure that's quite it either, but... How do you suppose I could tell the plants apart?
records.en: I'm not sure that's quite it either, but... How do you suppose I could tell the plants apart?

records.jp: うーん。私も詳しくないからなぁ……^00ちょっと考えさせて
records.en_original: Hmm. I'm no botanist, either... Give me a while to think about it.
records.en: Hmm. I'm no botanist, either... Give me a while to think about it.

records.jp: 詩さん、なんか困ってることない？
records.en_original: Uta, is there anything you've been having trouble with?
records.en: Uta, is there anything you've been having trouble with?

records.jp: 実は、少し相談したいことがあるのですが……。^00会ってお話しても良いですか？
records.en_original: Actually there is something I'd like to talk about. Can we meet?
records.en: Actually there is something I'd like to talk about. Can we meet?

records.jp: いいよ！　すぐ行くね！
records.en_original: Sure! I'll go right now!
records.en: Sure! I'll go right now!

records.jp: 星崎さん、料理の件はありがとうございました。^00私も少しは、みなさんの役に立てそうです
records.en_original: Thank you for your help the other day, Ao. It looks like I might be able to be of help after all.
records.en: Thank you for your help the other day, Ao. It looks like I might be able to be of help after all.

records.jp: どういたしまして、だよ。それよりさ……^00詩さんが楽しかったらいいなって思うけど
records.en_original: You're very welcome. But more importantly, I hope you had fun.
records.en: You're very welcome. But more importantly, I hope you had fun.

records.jp: はい。いろいろ教えて頂けて、楽しかったです。^00だから……料理にも興味が持てました
records.en_original: I did. I learned quite a lot. I...am actually much more interested in cooking now.
records.en: I did. I learned quite a lot. I...am actually much more interested in cooking now.

records.jp: マジで！？　よかった！
records.en_original: Really?! I'm so glad to hear it!
records.en: Really?! I'm so glad to hear it!

records.jp: ……星崎さんは、私が楽しいと……^00喜んでくれるんですか？
records.en_original: You are...happy when I have fun?
records.en: You are...happy when I have fun?

records.jp: そりゃそうだよ！　役に立ちたいってのは嬉しいよ？^00でも、詩さんが楽しくなきゃ、意味ないし
records.en_original: Well, of course! I'm glad you want to be helpful, but you enjoying yourself is the most important thing!
records.en: Well, of course! I'm glad you want to be helpful, but you enjoying yourself is the most important thing!

records.jp: 私が……楽しくないと、意味がない……
records.en_original: It's the most important thing...?
records.en: It's the most important thing...?

records.jp: うん。だってせっかくこうして知り会えたんだし、^00友達が楽しいと、私も楽しいしさ
records.en_original: That's right. It seems pretty special that we all met here and became friends. If my friends are happy, then so am I.
records.en: That's right. It seems pretty special that we all met here and became friends. If my friends are happy, then so am I.

records.jp: それでは……お言葉に甘えて、お願いしても^00いいでしょうか？
records.en_original: Then... If what you say is true, I'd like to make a request.
records.en: Then... If what you say is true, I'd like to make a request.

records.jp: もっと料理を研究してみたいので、いろいろな^00食材を使ってみたいんです
records.en_original: I'd like to work more on my cooking, so to that end, I need a variety of ingredients.
records.en: I'd like to work more on my cooking, so to that end, I need a variety of ingredients.

records.jp: いろんな食材だね！^00わかった！　集めてみるね！
records.en_original: A variety, huh? You got it! I'll go gather 'em for you!
records.en: A variety, huh? You got it! I'll go gather 'em for you!

records.jp: ……この世界は、いつでも夏なんですね
records.en_original: It's always summer here, isn't it?
records.en: It's always summer here, isn't it?

records.jp: だねー。^00やっぱ暑いっていうか……あ、夏って苦手？
records.en_original: Sure feels like it. It's so hot... Do you not like summer, Uta?
records.en: Sure feels like it. It's so hot... Do you not like summer, Uta?

records.jp: いえ、そういうわけではないのですが、^00いつも夏らしい日光ばかりだと、少し疲れますね
records.en_original: It's not that... But being under the hot summer sun all the time can be quite tiring.
records.en: It's not that... But being under the hot summer sun all the time can be quite tiring.

records.jp: あ、ちょっと分かる！^00夏の太陽って、元気いっぱいって感じだもんねー
records.en_original: I get that! The sun seems to burn really bright in the summer...
records.en: I get that! The sun seems to burn really bright in the summer...

records.jp: ここに来て初めて、四季の大切さを実感しました
records.en_original: Being here has made me appreciate the four seasons for the first time.
records.en: Being here has made me appreciate the four seasons for the first time.

records.jp: 時折、秋の夕暮れのような光があったら^00ほっとするような気持ちになります
records.en_original: The soft light of a fall evening is very calming. Sometimes I wish I could see that here.
records.en: The soft light of a fall evening is very calming. Sometimes I wish I could see that here.

records.jp: あ、いいよね、秋の夕暮れ。^00ほっとするけど、どこか寂しいみたいな……
records.en_original: Ah, autumn sunsets are so beautiful. They are calming, but there's also a melancholy to them...
records.en: Ah, autumn sunsets are so beautiful. They are calming, but there's also a melancholy to them...

records.jp: 星崎さんの言葉は、とても分かりやすいです。^00私も、似たような気持ちを感じていました
records.en_original: The way you phrase things is so easy to understand. That's exactly how I feel.
records.en: The way you phrase things is so easy to understand. That's exactly how I feel.

records.jp: ……いっそのこと作っちゃおっか！^00もちろん、秋の夕暮れまでは無理だけど……
records.en_original: Maybe we can make it ourselves! Obviously, making an actual autumn sunset isn't possible, but...
records.en: Maybe we can make it ourselves! Obviously, making an actual autumn sunset isn't possible, but...

records.jp: もっと光が弱くて、どこかほっとするけど^00ちょっと寂しいような気分になれるもの……うーん
records.en_original: What could we make that gives off a soft, calming light with a hint of melancholy? Hmm...
records.en: What could we make that gives off a soft, calming light with a hint of melancholy? Hmm...

records.jp: ……それなら、街燈などはどうでしょうか。^00古風な街燈にも、似た気持ちを覚えます
records.en_original: What do you think of a streetlamp? I remember getting a similar feeling from an old-fashioned light.
records.en: What do you think of a streetlamp? I remember getting a similar feeling from an old-fashioned light.

records.jp: 古風……レトロな街燈か。いいね！^00よーし！　作ってみよー！
records.en_original: Old-fashioned... Like one of those Victorian streetlamps. Perfect! Time to get to work!
records.en: Old-fashioned... Like one of those Victorian streetlamps. Perfect! Time to get to work!

records.jp: 詩さん、料理の方はどう？^00いろいろ試してみてるって、詩帆さんから聞いたよ！
records.en_original: How's the cooking coming along, Uta? Shiho told me you've been trying out a lot of different things!
records.en: How's the cooking coming along, Uta? Shiho told me you've been trying out a lot of different things!

records.jp: はい。みなさんに基本から教えて頂いて、^00お手伝いもできるようになりました
records.en_original: I am. Now that they've taught me the basics, I'm able to help them as well.
records.en: I am. Now that they've taught me the basics, I'm able to help them as well.

records.jp: いつもみなさんが作っているものは、^00私もどうにか作れるようになったんです
records.en_original: I can make almost anything that they usually make.
records.en: I can make almost anything that they usually make.

records.jp: ええーっ！　詩さん、すごいじゃん！
records.en_original: Ooh! That's great progress, Uta!
records.en: Ooh! That's great progress, Uta!

records.jp: でも、これではまだまだお手伝いの域です。^00私も、自分で考えた料理を振舞いたいんですが……
records.en_original: Though I still am just a helper. Someday, I'd like to present a meal that I thought of myself.
records.en: Though I still am just a helper. Someday, I'd like to present a meal that I thought of myself.

records.jp: 春日さんや美弦さんのように、何を作ればいいか^00思いつくことができなくて……
records.en_original: But I just seem to be unable to think of things to make like Shiho and Mio...
records.en: But I just seem to be unable to think of things to make like Shiho and Mio...

records.jp: あはは……詩帆さんたちは、お料理歴長いしねー
records.en_original: Ahaha... Well, they have a ton of experience cooking.
records.en: Ahaha... Well, they have a ton of experience cooking.

records.jp: お料理歴を積めば、思いつくんでしょうか？^00もどかしい……ですね……
records.en_original: So I'll need years of practice first? That's...disappointing.
records.en: So I'll need years of practice first? That's...disappointing.

records.jp: うーん。あ、そうだ！　作ってほしいものが^00あるんだけど、私のアイディアでもいい？
records.en_original: Hmm... Oh, I know! I have an idea for something I want you to make! Would that work?
records.en: Hmm... Oh, I know! I have an idea for something I want you to make! Would that work?

records.jp: もちろんです！
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: ええとね。「ハデス弁当」っていうんだけど……
records.en_original: All right, so... It's called a Hades Lunch, and...
records.en: All right, so... It's called a Hades Lunch, and...

records.jp: 分かりました。作ってみますね
records.en_original: I understand. Let's give it a shot.
records.en: I understand. Let's give it a shot.

records.jp: うん！　がんばろー！
records.en_original: Okay! We've got this!
records.en: Okay! We've got this!

records.jp: さっき放送で流れてたピアノの曲、誰が流してるんだろ^00日菜子さんあたりかな？
records.en_original: I wonder who picked that piano piece that was played before? My guess is Hinako.
records.en: I wonder who picked that piano piece that was played before? My guess is Hinako.

records.jp: ピアノ曲……きれいな音です
records.en_original: A piano piece... It's beautiful.
records.en: A piano piece... It's beautiful.

records.jp: だね……っていっても、^00なんて曲かも知らないんだけど
records.en_original: It is. But I don't think I know this one.
records.en: It is. But I don't think I know this one.

records.jp: 私も、知りません。^00でも……素敵な音だと思います
records.en_original: I don't know it, either. But it is a wonderful sound.
records.en: I don't know it, either. But it is a wonderful sound.

records.jp: 詩さん、ピアノって好きなの？
records.en_original: Do you like the piano, Uta?
records.en: Do you like the piano, Uta?

records.jp: そうですね……ピアノの音は、好きです。^00もし生の音が聴けたら、素敵ですね
records.en_original: Hmmm... I do like the sound of the piano. Being able to listen to it live would be really special.
records.en: Hmmm... I do like the sound of the piano. Being able to listen to it live would be really special.

records.jp: だよね！　もしさ、学校にピアノあったら、^00誰か弾いてくれるかもしれないよね
records.en_original: I agree! If we had a piano at the school, maybe someone would play for us.
records.en: I agree! If we had a piano at the school, maybe someone would play for us.

records.jp: そしたら、ミニコンサートなんかもできて、^00楽しいかも！
records.en_original: We could have a little concert! That'd be fun!
records.en: We could have a little concert! That'd be fun!

records.jp: 誰も弾くことができなくても、^00鍵盤を叩くだけでも、音を楽しめますね
records.en_original: Even if none of us knows how to play, we could still enjoy the sounds the keys make.
records.en: Even if none of us knows how to play, we could still enjoy the sounds the keys make.

records.jp: じゃあさ、ピアノ作っちゃおうか！^00この際、すごい立派なやつ！
records.en_original: Then why don't we make a piano? A really big, beautiful one!
records.en: Then why don't we make a piano? A really big, beautiful one!

records.jp: 立派なピアノというと……^00グランドピアノでしょうか
records.en_original: By big...do you mean a grand piano?
records.en: By big...do you mean a grand piano?

records.jp: グランドピアノだね！^00よーし！　作っちゃおう！
records.en_original: Yeah, a grand piano! Okay, I'll get to work!
records.en: Yeah, a grand piano! Okay, I'll get to work!

records.jp: 星崎さんにとって、「心が休まる」ようなものは、^00どんなものですか？
records.en_original: Ao, what would you say puts your heart at ease?
records.en: Ao, what would you say puts your heart at ease?

records.jp: 心が休まる……かぁ。^00かわいいものとか、かなあ。動物とか
records.en_original: Let me think... Cute things, I guess? Like animals.
records.en: Let me think... Cute things, I guess? Like animals.

records.jp: もふもふした小動物とか、^00抱いてると癒されるよねー
records.en_original: Fluffy little critters that make you feel warm and fuzzy when you hold them.
records.en: Fluffy little critters that make you feel warm and fuzzy when you hold them.

records.jp: もふもふ……星崎さんは、それで^00心が休まるのですね……
records.en_original: Fluffy... I see.
records.en: Fluffy... I see.

records.jp: ……もふもふと言えば、子供のころに^00一体だけ好きだったぬいぐるみがありました
records.en_original: That reminds me that when I was younger I had a single plushie that I loved.
records.en: That reminds me that when I was younger I had a single plushie that I loved.

records.jp: 気付いた時には、おそらく親に捨てられて^00部屋から無くなっていましたが……
records.en_original: One day, I realized that it had disappeared from my room. Apparently my parents had thrown it out.
records.en: One day, I realized that it had disappeared from my room. Apparently my parents had thrown it out.

records.jp: え、大事だったのに、そんな……。^00……どんな子だったの？
records.en_original: What? I can't believe they would do that to something so important to you... What was it like?
records.en: What? I can't believe they would do that to something so important to you... What was it like?

records.jp: 大きなクマで、老けた顔の印象がありました。^00幼い私にとって、頼もしく見えたのかもしれません
records.en_original: It was a big bear with an old face. I think that made it look trustworthy to me as a child.
records.en: It was a big bear with an old face. I think that made it look trustworthy to me as a child.

records.jp: それがもしかしたら、詩さんにとって^00心が休まるものだったのかもしれないね
records.en_original: That's probably something that put your heart at ease, Uta.
records.en: That's probably something that put your heart at ease, Uta.

records.jp: そうだったんでしょうか……^00そんな気も……します
records.en_original: I think so... I get the feeling that it did.
records.en: I think so... I get the feeling that it did.

records.jp: それじゃあさ、でっかいクマのぬいぐるみ、^00作ってみようよ！
records.en_original: So then why don't we make a big stuffed bear?
records.en: So then why don't we make a big stuffed bear?

records.jp: 誰かが校内放送で音楽を流してるみたいだね
records.en_original: Sounds like someone's playing music over the PA system.
records.en: Sounds like someone's playing music over the PA system.

records.jp: 空間に音楽が満ちる……。^00なんとも贅沢な使い方ですね
records.en_original: Having music playing faintly in the background like this feels classy.
records.en: Having music playing faintly in the background like this feels classy.

records.jp: 詩さんは、音楽を聴くときはスピーカー派？^00ヘッドホンとかイヤホン派？
records.en_original: Uta, do you prefer listening to music over speakers, or are you more of a headphones kind of girl?
records.en: Uta, do you prefer listening to music over speakers, or are you more of a headphones kind of girl?

records.jp: ヘッドホンとかの方でしょうか。^00やはり、耳元で細かな音を聞き分けたいですので
records.en_original: Headphones, I'd say. I want to make out all the intricacies of the music.
records.en: Headphones, I'd say. I want to make out all the intricacies of the music.

records.jp: わかる。普通の家庭じゃスピーカーで^00ジャカジャカしたら近所迷惑になっちゃうのもあるけど
records.en_original: I get that. And playing music over speakers might bother the people around you...
records.en: I get that. And playing music over speakers might bother the people around you...

records.jp: でも、スピーカーならではの迫力も捨てがたい……
records.en_original: But speakers have this special oomph to them that's hard to pass up!
records.en: But speakers have this special oomph to them that's hard to pass up!

records.jp: 迫力で言うなら……^00詩さんはライブとかコンサートとか行ったことある？
records.en_original: That makes me wonder... Have you ever been to a concert, Uta?
records.en: That makes me wonder... Have you ever been to a concert, Uta?

records.jp: どうでしょう……恐らくないと思います
records.en_original: Have I...? Unfortunately, I don't believe I have.
records.en: Have I...? Unfortunately, I don't believe I have.

records.jp: それはもったいないよ！^00元の世界に戻ったらぜひ行ってみて！
records.en_original: That is unfortunate! When we get back to our world, you've definitely gotta go see one!
records.en: That is unfortunate! When we get back to our world, you've definitely gotta go see one!

records.jp: 肺に伝わる振動とか、ビリビリする頭とか……。^00音を体で感じられるのが楽しいから！
records.en_original: You can feel the music in your whole body! The beat thumping in your chest, pounding in your head...
records.en: You can feel the music in your whole body! The beat thumping in your chest, pounding in your head...

records.jp: 楽しい……でしょうか？^00ただ私は、あまり人が多く集まるところは……
records.en_original: Is that...fun? And I'm not really good with crowds...
records.en: Is that...fun? And I'm not really good with crowds...

records.jp: じゃあさ、今のうちに慣れてみようよ！^00元の世界で、楽しめるようにさ！
records.en_original: In that case, why don't you try getting used to it now so you're ready to go when we get back?
records.en: In that case, why don't you try getting used to it now so you're ready to go when we get back?

records.jp: ……そうですね。^00星崎さんが一緒なら、楽しめる気がしますし
records.en_original: Yeah. I think I'd enjoy it if I were with you, Ao.
records.en: Yeah. I think I'd enjoy it if I were with you, Ao.

records.jp: よーし！　それじゃ、コンサート会場を^00作っちゃおう！
records.en_original: All right! Let's build a concert venue, then!
records.en: All right! Let's build a concert venue, then!

records.jp: ねえ、愛央。ちょっといいかな？
records.en_original: Ao, do you have a minute?
records.en: Ao, do you have a minute?

records.jp: どしたの？　何か困りごと？
records.en_original: What's up? Anything wrong?
records.en: What's up? Anything wrong?

records.jp: 実はライムがね、この間ココロトープに行った時に、^00落とし物をしちゃったらしくて
records.en_original: Well, you see, apparently Lime forgot something in the Heartscape the other day.
records.en: Well, you see, apparently Lime forgot something in the Heartscape the other day.

records.jp: 落とし物？　何落としたの？
records.en_original: Really? What did she forget?
records.en: Really? What did she forget?

records.jp: スマホ
records.en_original: Her phone.
records.en: Her phone.

records.jp: ええっ！？　大変じゃん
records.en_original: Seriously?! That's not good!
records.en: Seriously?! That's not good!

records.jp: 探してあげようと思うんだけど、^00愛央も手伝ってくれないかなあって。ダメかな？
records.en_original: I'm thinking of going to look for it. Would you mind giving me a hand?
records.en: I'm thinking of going to look for it. Would you mind giving me a hand?

records.jp: もちろんいいよ。^00今度一緒に探しに行こ！
records.en_original: Of course I'll help! Let's go take a look soon.
records.en: Of course I'll help! Let's go take a look soon.

records.jp: ありがとう！　助かるよ
records.en_original: Thank you! I appreciate it.
records.en: Thank you! I appreciate it.

records.jp: ねえ、愛央ちゃん。^00わたしの化粧ポーチ知らない？
records.en_original: Hey Ao, have you seen my makeup pouch anywhere?
records.en: Hey Ao, have you seen my makeup pouch anywhere?

records.jp: え？　見てないけど……
records.en_original: Sorry, but nope...
records.en: Sorry, but nope...

records.jp: んー……やっぱり落としてきちゃったのかなあ。^00どうしよう……
records.en_original: Shoot... I had a feeling I dropped it out there. What to do...
records.en: Shoot... I had a feeling I dropped it out there. What to do...

records.jp: 「落としてきた」……って、もしかして！？
records.en_original: When you say "out there," do you mean...?
records.en: When you say "out there," do you mean...?

records.jp: うん。たぶん、ココロトープに行った時に^00落としちゃったと思うんだよね……
records.en_original: Yeah, I think I dropped it in my Heartscape last time I was there...
records.en: Yeah, I think I dropped it in my Heartscape last time I was there...

records.jp: そりゃ、一大事だ……
records.en_original: That's no good…
records.en: That's no good…

records.jp: よし、今度探しに行こうよ。私も手伝うし
records.en_original: Let's go look for it next time we're in there. I'll help you find it.
records.en: Let's go look for it next time we're in there. I'll help you find it.

records.jp: 本当？　ありがとう、助かるよ
records.en_original: Really? That would be great, thank you.
records.en: Really? That would be great, thank you.

records.jp: 星崎さん、頼みたいことがあるんだけど……
records.en_original: Hoshizaki, I'd like to ask a favor...
records.en: Hoshizaki, I'd like to ask a favor...

records.jp: 伶那さんが頼み事？　珍しいね
records.en_original: You need something Rena? That's unusual.
records.en: You need something Rena? That's unusual.

records.jp: ちょっと描きたい絵があって。^00現地まで付き合ってもらえない？
records.en_original: There's a place I'd like to draw. Would you mind joining me?
records.en: There's a place I'd like to draw. Would you mind joining me?

records.jp: 現地……って？
records.en_original: A place?
records.en: A place?

records.jp: 私のココロトープの一番奥
records.en_original: The deepest part of my Heartscape.
records.en: The deepest part of my Heartscape.

records.jp: えっ！？　あそこまで行くの！？
records.en_original: You want to go all the way there?!
records.en: You want to go all the way there?!

records.jp: どうしてもあの景色をスケッチしたくて……。^00こんなこと、星崎さんにしか頼めないし……
records.en_original: I want to sketch the view there... You're the only one I can ask, Hoshizaki...
records.en: I want to sketch the view there... You're the only one I can ask, Hoshizaki...

records.jp: あはは、そう言われると断りづらいなあ。^00おっけー、任せといて
records.en_original: Ahaha, when you put it that way, how can I say no? All right, you can count on me!
records.en: Ahaha, when you put it that way, how can I say no? All right, you can count on me!

records.jp: ……ありがと
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.

records.jp: ねえ、愛央ちゃん。^00ちょっと私の悩みを聞いてもらえない？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao. Could I get your advice on something?
records.en: Hey, Ao. Could I get your advice on something?

records.jp: ん？　どしたの？
records.en_original: Hm? What's up?
records.en: Hm? What's up?

records.jp: 実は、この間伶那さんに怒られちゃってさ。^00「あなたの戦い方は危なっかしい」って
records.en_original: Well, Rena got mad at me the other day. She thinks I'm too reckless when I fight.
records.en: Well, Rena got mad at me the other day. She thinks I'm too reckless when I fight.

records.jp: あー……
records.en_original: Ahh...
records.en: Ahh...

records.jp: ついつい突っ込んでいっちゃうところがあるから、^00それを直した方が良いって言われたんだけど……
records.en_original: She said I should stop rushing into the thick of things without thinking...
records.en: She said I should stop rushing into the thick of things without thinking...

records.jp: どうしたらいいのかわからなくてさ……。^00なんかいい方法ないかなあ？
records.en_original: Do you have any ideas? I don't know what to do...
records.en: Do you have any ideas? I don't know what to do...

records.jp: んー、敵と戦うんじゃなくて、^00逃げたり、隠れたりする練習をしてみるとか？
records.en_original: Hmmm, how about instead of fighting, we practice hiding or running away?
records.en: Hmmm, how about instead of fighting, we practice hiding or running away?

records.jp: 隠れる練習かあ……。考えたこともなかったなあ
records.en_original: Practice hiding, huh... I never would have thought of that.
records.en: Practice hiding, huh... I never would have thought of that.

records.jp: もしやるなら私も一緒に行くよ。^00私も似たようなことよく言われるし
records.en_original: If you want, I'll practice with you. I've had people tell me that I have a similar problem.
records.en: If you want, I'll practice with you. I've had people tell me that I have a similar problem.

records.jp: ほんと！？　心強いよ～
records.en_original: Really? That would be great!
records.en: Really? That would be great!

records.jp: 星崎さん、ちょっといいでしょうか？
records.en_original: Ao, do you have a moment?
records.en: Ao, do you have a moment?

records.jp: どしたの？
records.en_original: What's up?
records.en: What's up?

records.jp: あの、こころから聞いたんですけど……。^00ココロトープにわたしたちが作った秘密基地があるって
records.en_original: I was talking with Kokoro, and... She mentioned a secret hideout that we had built together in her Heartscape.
records.en: I was talking with Kokoro, and... She mentioned a secret hideout that we had built together in her Heartscape.

records.jp: ああ、うん。正確には、こころが考えてた^00理想の秘密基地……って感じみたいだけど
records.en_original: Oh, yeah. It's more like her idealized version of what you built in her memories.
records.en: Oh, yeah. It's more like her idealized version of what you built in her memories.

records.jp: やっぱり気になる？
records.en_original: Do you want to see it?
records.en: Do you want to see it?

records.jp: はい。^00でも、こころに話すのもちょっと恥ずかしくて……
records.en_original: Yes. Though I'm too embarrassed to say anything to Kokoro...
records.en: Yes. Though I'm too embarrassed to say anything to Kokoro...

records.jp: もしよければ、案内してもらえないかと……
records.en_original: I was wondering if you could show me...
records.en: I was wondering if you could show me...

records.en: What's up?

records.en: Are you sure I'm the one to ask? Cooking isn't really my strong suit...

records.en: Well, if you're sure... Though I am just a little worried.

records.en: Ao. Something terrible has happened.

records.en: Whoa, what's wrong?

records.en: I sense a dark presence in my Heartscape...

records.en: A dark presence... Why do I feel like I've heard that before? Can you be more specific?

records.en: I don't know, but I fear something terrible... We must go and check ourselves.

records.en_original: All right, I'll go check it out.
records.en: All right, I'll go check it out.

records.en: What?! But...

records.en: Something feels strange this time... It may be dangerous by yourself.

records.en: I've got it!

records.en: If we don't have one, we can just make one! The luxurious lounge of luxury!

records.en: We're just getting started!

records.en: I'm not even close to satisfied. There's so much more we could build!
